jobs.description: BERNER pushing the limits – for those who dare moreMaking a choice about your career and your employer is a choice about your future - a future where you will invest your passion and a large portion of your time, energy, and capacity.  Play a key role in ensuring that our products meet applicable legal and regulatory requirements and contribute to maintaining a compliant and market-ready product portfolio. You will combine your scientific or technical background with an interest in regulatory requirements, chemical product data and legislation. From monitoring regulatory developments and assessing product compliance to preparing Safety Data Sheets and maintaining chemical data, you will translate complex requirements into practical solutions for our products and business processes. Join our Product Compliance team and take an active role in securing product conformity while working closely with Product Management, Purchasing, Quality and our suppliers, as well as supporting our customers with product compliance-related topics.YOUR TASKS- Ensure that our products meet applicable legal and regulatory product compliance requirements- Monitor current and upcoming product legislation and assess its impact on different product groups and our portfolio- Assess chemical products regarding applicable regulatory requirements, particularly REACH, CLP, Biocidal Products Regulation, Detergents Regulation, Cosmetic Product Regulation and the Construction Products Regulation- Create, review and maintain Safety Data Sheets (SDS) and ensure their regulatory compliance and quality- Maintain and ensure the quality of chemical, substance and compliance-related product data in relevant systems- Analyse product compositions, classifications and regulatory product information and derive necessary compliance measures- Review supplier documentation, clarify regulatory requirements with suppliers and verify the completeness and plausibility of provided compliance information- Prepare and maintain compliance-related documents, declarations and certificates- Maintain product and compliance data in SAP, PIM and other relevant systems- Work closely with Product Management and Purchasing during the creation and introduction of new products to identify and implement compliance requirements at an early stage- Support Master Data Management in defining and maintaining legally required product information- Support customers and our subsidiaries with product compliance-related questions and provide relevant regulatory documentation and information- Contribute to the implementation of new and changing regulatory requirements as well as the continuous improvement and digitalization of Product Compliance processesYOUR PROFILE- Academic degree or comparable qualification with a scientific, technical or regulatory background, for example in chemistry, chemical engineering, environmental sciences, materials science, life sciences or a related field- Strong analytical skills, a high level of accuracy and a structured, reliable working style- Enjoy working with chemical and technical data as well as complex legal and regulatory requirements- Ideally, knowledge of European chemical and product legislation, particularly: - REACH Regulation- CLP Regulation- Biocidal Products Regulation- Detergents Regulation- Construction Products Regulation- Cosmetic Product Regulation- Knowledge of PPE legislation is an advantage- Experience in creating and maintaining Safety Data Sheets is an advantage- Experience with SDS authoring via chemical compliance software such as Chemdox is an advantage- High affinity for data and confidence in handling and maintaining larger amounts of technical and regulatory product information- Confident user of Microsoft Excel, Word and PowerPoint- Experience with SAP, PIM systems or comparable product data systems is an advantage- Strong communication and teamwork skills and confidence in collaborating with different business functions, suppliers, customers and external partners- Good English skills; German or additional European language skills are an advantage WHY BERNER? - Job bike leasing (JobRad)  - Commuting allowance  - Wellpass membership & corporate benefits  - Company pension scheme  - Opportunities for further training  - Technically modern equipped workplace  - Company restaurant in Künzelsau or meal vouchers in Cologne  - Attractive conditions for our products in the BERNER online shop Apply Now – We’re Excited to Meet You! Please submit your application via our online form, including your availability and salary expectations. The BERNER Group is a European trading company serving professionals in the mobility, construction, and industrial sectors. We are the leading B2B specialist and an innovative manufacturer of chemical products. Our purpose is: “We are pushing the limits of the possible for the shapers of a better tomorrow.” With our strong brands - BERNER, BTI by BERNER, and CCS - we empower our customers to keep their businesses running successfully. Join our team and shape the future with us! The BERNER Group as employer, dare to differentiate ourselves and provide every employee the opportunity to and enable them to dare to be more.  Together, we push our own limits and contribute to shape a better tomorrow.

jobs.description: IRC (International Rescue Committee) Germany is seeking aProgram Development & Award Advisor (d/f/m), Latin America- in Berlin, or remote (within Germany) | as soon as possible- in part-time (20 hours/week), increase to full-time in the future might be possible (contingent upon funding) | initially for 2 yearsAbout UsFounded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC offers lifesaving care and life-changing assistance to refugees forced to flee from war or disaster. In 2016, IRC Germany was founded and engages in global humanitarian work as well as throughout Germany in the areas of education, economic wellbeing, and safety, legal protection, and empowerment.IRC’s Crisis Response, Recovery and Development Department (CRRD) runs humanitarian relief, recovery, and development programs focused on safety, health, education, economic well-being, and people’s power to influence decisions, with particular attention to women and girls. Its Awards Management Unit (AMU) secures and manages government donor funding, bridging donors and country programs while ensuring compliance and managing risk. In Latin America and the Caribbean, the IRC responds to crises in Colombia, Ecuador, Venezuela, Mexico, Central America, and Haiti, supporting displaced and host communities through local partners and direct implementation. The Program Development and Award Advisor (PDAA) provides pre- and post-award support to country offices, ensures donor and IRC compliance, leads donor deliverables, and manages donor relationships.Major Responsibilities- Strategic Business Development: support country offices in advancing strategic business development planning efforts, donor engagement, intelligence gathering, positioning and capture. Prepare for and participate in donor meetings, engagement calls, and strategic discussions as needed. - Proposal development: provide quality assurance and quality compliance support on proposals, leading proposal development and coordination as needed. Ensure responsiveness to and compliance with solicitation documents and with IRC’s requirements and policies. - Award portfolio management: manage a portfolio of awards and act as the first point of contact for country award staff on compliance issues. Review agreements and lead negotiation of award terms and conditions with donor counterparts. - Partnerships: guide country offices in managing local and international partners in line with IRC’s PEERs system, and review and process sub-grant agreements. - Monitoring: monitor projects to ensure progress against objectives and compliance with donor guidelines and IRC internal requirements. Monitoring awards can take the shape of monitoring visits, participation in routine meetings and other regular calls. - Experience writing, reviewing and editing funding proposals and other donor deliverables and excellent attention to detail.- Excellent written and oral communication skills, including experience in speaking on relevant issues with internal and external audiences.- English and Spanish language skills at C1-level according to the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CERF) (https://www.europaeischer-referenzrahmen.de/) . Additional knowledge of French and/or German highly desirable.- Solid organizational and creative problem-solving skills: ability to be flexible and work well under pressure in a fast-paced multi-tasking team environment- Excellent IT skills (Word, Outlook, Excel)- Ability and willingness to travel internationally (up to 15 %)- Reporting: provide timely support on narrative reporting, amendments, and modifications. Ensure timely submission of high-quality donor deliverables.- Donor liaison: manage donor relationships on contractual issues, compliance queries and approvals, and represent IRC externally at events and meetings.- Capacity building: mentor Grants and Partnerships staff, develop and deliver training, and support recruitment and onboarding of new team members.- Other duties: contribute to AMU and regional strategic priorities, work with communications teams on donor communication products, and maintain checklists and work processes and systems. Your Profile- Significant work experience in award management or business development with EU donors, particularly ECHO, and other public donors. Experience with and a strong understanding of institutional donors’ compliance requirements.- Two years of international field experience highly desirable, familiarity with countries in the region preferred.- Excellent interpersonal & communication skills: ability to successfully and effectively liaise with people within and across departments in a multi-cultural environment.- Good financial management and budgeting skills- Ability to analyze and synthesize information, work collaboratively as part of a diverse team, handle complex tasks, and work independently We Offer- Meaningful work within a collaborative team- A starting salary between 32.000 and 33.500 Euro gross per year (for part-time, 20 hours/week) as well as an annual salary increase- Attractive employee benefits such as gym membership, company pension scheme, shopping vouchers, childcare subsidy, job bike leasing, subsidized Deutschlandticket (national public transport), and access to timely and confidential psychological support if needed- 30 days of annual leave and special leave days- Flexible hybrid-work options (working hours, office/homebased)- Training and professional development opportunities, including access to free language courses- Assistance services for people with disabilities, if required.We look forward to receiving your application (including CV and – if available – three references) via our application portal (https://theirc.wd1.myworkdayjobs.com/de-DE/External_Careers/job/Berlin-Germany/Program-Development---Award-Advisor--d-f-m---Latin-America_JR00006189) – even if you do not meet all the listed requirements. For questions, please contact Friederike Haarbrücker (HR.Deutschland@rescue.org (https://mailto:HR.Deutschland@rescue.org) ).As an organization committed to an empowering work environment, equal opportunities, and against any form of discrimination, we welcome applications from people regardless of their origin, religion, gender, sexual orientation, disabilities, age, or other characteristics protected by applicable law. We particularly encourage people with personal or family experience of flight and migration to apply.With equal qualifications, we give preference to applications from people with severe disabilities. If you have any questions about accessible applications or inclusion, please feel free to contact our Inclusion Officer, Christine Mader (christine.mader@rescue.org (https://mailto:christine.mader@rescue.org) ).To ensure equal opportunities, we kindly ask you to refrain from including photos in your application documents.There is no specific application deadline for this job posting. The position needs to be filled as soon as possible and will remain posted until filled.All IRC workers must adhere to the core values and principles outlined in IRC Way - Standards for Professional Conduct (https://www.rescue.org/page/our-code-conduct) . On this basis, the IRC operates and enforces policies on Safeguarding (https://www.rescue.org/page/safeguarding) , Conflicts of Interest, Fiscal Integrity, and Anti-Retaliation.You can find more information about IRC Germany at IRCDeutschland.org (https://www.irc-deutschland.org/) .Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach Vereinbarung

The GFZ Helmholtz Centre for Geosciences is one of the world's leading institutions in the field of geosciences. As part of the Helmholtz Association, Germany's largest research organisation, we address global challenges such as natural hazards, climate change and the sustainable use of resources. In doing so, we combine cutting-edge research with social relevance. Our international staff - around 1,200 employees and approx. 500 guests - work in a multidisciplinary way and with a unique infrastructure to research the dynamic processes of the Earth system. Our vision: "Taking the pulse of our Earth to safeguard a habitable planet."For section 2.1 "Physics of Earthquakes and Volcanoes" (https://www.gfz.de/en/section/physics-of-earthquakes-and-volcanoes/overview) (department “Geophysics (https://www.gfz.de/en/geophysics) ”), we are looking for a:Research scientist (f_m_x) - SeismologyReference Number 11691Earthquakes induced by human activities, such as deep geothermal energy production, can cause ground shaking that raises concerns among local communities. Understanding earthquake source processes and predicting the resulting ground motions, including their uncertainties, are important for assessing seismic impacts and supporting transparent communication with stakeholders.Within the BMWE-funded collaborative project "Seismological Analysis and Societal Relevance of Deep Energy Projects (SAURIER)", GFZ is responsible for the subproject "TRansparent Interpretation and Characterisation of Earthquake RAdiation Patterns through probabilistic moment TensOr inversion and PGV Simulations (TRICERATOPS)". We are looking for a motivated researcher with a strong background in seismology and experience in earthquake source analysis and seismic waveform processing.The successful candidate will contribute to developing and applying probabilistic methods for earthquake source characterisation and physics-based ground motion modelling. The research will focus on quantifying the influence of earthquake source parameters and subsurface structure on predicted ground motions and their uncertainties, with the aim of estimating seismic impact zones.Fraunhofer IEG coordinates SAURIER and brings together seismological and social science research to improve the assessment and communication of induced seismicity.Your responsibilities:- Analyse seismic waveform datasets and determine earthquake source parameters, particularly for small to moderate earthquakes, using probabilistic methods including uncertainty quantification- Integrate earthquake source parameters and their uncertainties into physics-based ground motion simulations using numerical modelling tools such as Pyrocko and its Green's function modelling framework- Investigate the sensitivity of predicted ground motions to source parameters, including focal mechanism, source depth and rupture characteristics, as well as subsurface structure- Develop and validate probabilistic ground motion models for moderate earthquakes and contribute to the estimation of seismic impact zones- Develop, test and document scientific software and reproducible analysis workflows- Develop clear and accessible visualisations of earthquake source characteristics, probabilistic ground motion simulations and estimated seismic impact zones for different target groups, including scientists, authorities and the general public, in collaboration with social science partners at UFZ- Collaborate with project partners and contribute to the interpretation and communication of scientific results- Publish research results in peer-reviewed scientific journals and present findings at national and international conferences- Contribute to project reports, meetings and scientific outreach activitiesAbout You:Essential Qualifications:- A Master's degree (MSc) and a PhD in Earth Science, with a focus on seismology and geophysics- Solid geophysical and seismological background- Experience in local earthquake analysis, including moment tensor inversion- Good programming skills in Python, experience in scientific data processing, and experience in developing, adapting and validating computational methods for seismological research, including the implementation of reproducible workflows in Python- Familiarity with seismology toolboxes (e.g. Pyrocko, ObsPy) and visualisation tools (e.g. GMT, ParaView, QGIS)- Experience in scientific research, demonstrated through a convincing and strong publication record, software contributions and other research outputs appropriate to career stage- Good written and spoken English and the ability to communicate scientific results clearly- Experience in collaborative and externally funded research projectsDesirable Qualifications:- Experience in numerical seismic wave propagation or ground motion modelling- Knowledge of probabilistic inversion methods, uncertainty quantification or sensitivity analysis- Experience with induced seismicity and analysis of moderate earthquakesStart date: 1st April 2027Fixed-term: 24 MonateSalary: Die Stelle ist nach TVöD Bund mit der Entgeltgruppe 13 bewertet. Die Eingruppierung erfolgt nach den tariflichen Bestimmungen und den entsprechenden persönlichen Voraussetzungen.Working hours: Teilzeit 50% (derzeit 19,50 h/Woche)Place of work: PotsdamWhat we offer:- Ambitious and varied tasks in a dynamic and international research environment- State-of-the-art equipment- Public service benefits- Extensive training opportunities- Professional career advice offered by our in-house Career-Centre- Flexible working hours and conditions- Support with finding a good work-life balance offered by benefit@work- Institute day-care centre on siteHave we piqued your interest?If so, we look forward to receiving your application by 9th December 2026. Please use our online application form only.Required documents: letter of motivation, CV, academic degree certificates/gradesThe GFZ actively promotes diversity and equal opportunities. We explicitly welcome applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of ethnic and social origin, nationality, gender, sexual orientation and identity, religion/belief, age, and physical or neurodiverse abilities.“Diversity in perspectives” is one of GFZ's core values. As an integral part of supporting diversity at our centre, we actively promote women in science and in leadership positions. To know more about our Diversity policies, contact the diversity team. If you need more information about our gender equality policies, please do not hesitate to contact our Equal Opportunities Officer (https://www.gfz.de/en/career/the-gfz-as-an-employer/employee-representation) and check our Equal Opportunities Plan & Cascade Model (https://www.gfz.de/en/career/the-gfz-as-an-employer/equal-opportunities) .We look forward to applications from people who enjoy working in diverse teams, where everyone feels respected and valued and can fully develop their own talents. jobs.occupation: Research Scientist (m/f/d) in Archaeo- and Palaeogenomics (Tenure Track) (Archäologe/Archäologin)
jobs.description: Senckenberg – Leibniz Institution for Biodiversity and Earth System Research (SGN)  headquartered in Frankfurt am Main is seeking to fill the following position at the Senckenberg Centre for Human Evolution and Palaeoenvironment (SHEP) in Tübingen  as soon as possibleResearch Scientist (m/f/d) in Archaeo- and Palaeogenomics (Tenure Track)(full time / part time)Location:TübingenEmployment scope: full-time / part-time options availableType of contract: The position is initially offered on a fixed-term basis. The type and duration of the contract will depend on the successful candidate’s individual qualifications and profile, as well as the applicable legal framework, and may not exceed six years. Subject to a positive evaluation, the position is intended to lead to a permanent appointment under the Senckenberg tenure track scheme.Remuneration:  collective agreement of the German Länder, TV-L E 13﻿The Senckenberg Society for Nature Research is a member of the Leibniz Association and has been investigating the “Earth System” worldwide for more than 200 years, examining the past, analysing the present, and developing projections for the future. We conduct integrative geobiodiversity research with the aim of understanding nature in all its complexity and diversity in order to preserve it as the foundation of life for future generations and to ensure its sustainable use. Across eight institutes and five research stations throughout Germany, scientists from more than 40 countries conduct research at the highest international level. The Senckenberg Centre for Human Evolution and Palaeoenvironment (SHEP) is based in Tübingen, Baden-Württemberg.Since 2009, our scientists in Tübingen have been conducting research on the biological and cultural evolution of humans in their environments in close cooperation with the Eberhard-Karls-University of Tübingen.Your Responsibilities- Developing, planning and conducting archaeogenetic and palaeogenetic research projects within the framework of the SHEP research programme in Tübingen- Analysing ancient human DNA, particularly from Eurasia, and reconstructing the evolutionary and population history of ancient human populations- Investigating population structures, kinship patterns and forms of social organisation through the integration of genomic, archaeological and historical data- Scientifically coordinating the generation of new genomic data in collaboration with project partners, and contributing to the development and enhancement of bioinformatic analysis pipelines- Publishing research findings in international peer-reviewed journals, developing research proposals and contributing to third-party funding acquisition- Establishing and maintaining national and international research collaborations, and working closely with research groups at SHEP and the University of Tübingen- Providing academic and professional supervision to staff, as well as supervising doctoral researchers and students- Undertaking organisational responsibilities and coordinating collaborative research activities within the research groupYour Profile- A completed PhD in Archaeogenetics, Evolutionary Biology, Molecular Anthropology, Population Genetics or a related natural science discipline- Strong expertise in the analysis and interpretation of genomic data, particularly ancient DNA, combined with excellent bioinformatic skills- Proven experience in integrating genomic data with archaeological, anthropological and historical evidence- Knowledge of approaches to reconstructing population structures, kinship relationships and forms of social organisation in past communities- Experience in developing and applying genomic or bioinformatic methods; experience in developing computational pipelines would be an advantage- A strong academic publication record, including publications in internationally recognised peer-reviewed journals- Experience in planning, conducting or coordinating scientific research projects, together with the ability to independently develop research proposals and secure third-party funding- Experience in supervising students and early-career researchers- Excellent communication and collaboration skills, together with a strong interest in interdisciplinary research- Excellent written and spoken English, and a willingness to learn German** Desirable skills**- Research expertise in the genomics of early humans, particularly archaic hominins such as Neanderthals.- In-depth knowledge of the demography, population structure and evolutionary history of prehistoric human populations, particularly European hunter-gatherers.- Established national and international research collaborations in archaeogenetics and palaeogenomics.We offer- access to an international network of scientists, policymakers and research organizations- an attractive job within the inspired and dynamic working environment of an internationally recognized research institution- flexible working hours – mobile working options – employee ID card with free admission to Senckenberg museums – annual special payment – collectively agreed vacation entitlement – company pension planSenckenberg is committed to diversity. We benefit from the different expertise, perspectives and personalities of our staff and welcome every application from qualified candidates, irrespective of age, gender, ethnic or cultural origin, religion and ideology, sexual orientation and identity or disability. Women are particularly encouraged to apply, as they are underrepresented in the field of this position; in the case of equal qualifications and suitability they will be given preference. Applicants with a severe disability will be given special consideration in case of equal suitability. Senckenberg actively supports the compatibility of work and family and places great emphasis on an equal and inclusive work culture.How to apply?Please submit your complete application, including a cover letter, a research and development plan outlining how you intend to advance the research activities, a detailed CV, academic certificates and employment references, a list of publications and, where available, letters of recommendation, as a single PDF file via our careers portal https://www.senckenberg.de/de/stellenanzeigen/ by20December 2026.﻿**Please understand that we accept applications exclusively through our careers page. **ContactSenckenberg Gesellschaft für NaturforschungSenckenberganlage 2560325 Frankfurt am MainFor specific questions about this role, please contact Prof. Dr. Cosimo Posth at cosimo.posth@senckenberg.de.﻿If you have any questions about the application process, please feel free to contact us at recruiting@senckenberg.de.For data protection information on the processing of personal data as part of the application and selection process, please refer to the privacy policy on our homepage at https://www.senckenberg.de/en/imprint/.﻿For further information about the Senckenberg Gesellschaft für Naturforschung please visit www.senckenberg.de.

jobs.occupation: Postdoc (f_m_x) – Hydraulic Stimulation for Enhanced Geothermal Systems (Wissenschaftliche/r Mitarbeiter/in)
jobs.description: The GFZ Helmholtz Centre for Geosciences is one of the world's leading institutions in the field of geosciences. As part of the Helmholtz Association, Germany's largest research organisation, we address global challenges such as natural hazards, climate change and the sustainable use of resources. In doing so, we combine cutting-edge research with social relevance. Our international staff - around 1,200 employees and approx. 500 guests - work in a multidisciplinary way and with a unique infrastructure to research the dynamic processes of the Earth system. Our vision: "Taking the pulse of our Earth to safeguard a habitable planet."For the EU-funded project UPLIFT in section4.3 Geoenergy (https://www.gfz.de/en/section/geoenergy/overview) (department 'Geosystems (https://www.gfz.de/en/departments/geosystems) '), we are looking for a:Research scientist (f_m_x) – Geothermal Reservoir StimulationReference Number 11660UPLIFT (https://uplift-horizon.eu/) brings together key European Enhanced Geothermal System (EGS (https://www.geothermie.de/bibliothek/lexikon-der-geothermie/e/egs) ) industry and research institutions to demonstrate, at Czechia's leading energy research site RINGEN, how water-only multi-stage hydraulic shear stimulation treatments can be efficiently implemented in metamorphic basement rocks in Europe, while reducing technical, social, and environmental risks.A central focus is the development and application of adaptive stimulation designs that use real-time seismic and hydraulic data to improve treatment efficiency and safety. The project will also investigate micro-turbine drilling as an alternative to conventional perforation techniques to improve reservoir access. Laboratory experiments will assess the self-propping behaviour of European basement rocks and benchmark their stimulation response against acid- and proppant-based methods. Water-only and proppant-based stimulation treatments will also be compared at the Bedretto Underground Laboratory. In parallel, the project will develop high-fidelity, physics-based digital twins to guide stimulation design, alongside fast surrogate models to support real-time operational decision-making. teamsYour Qualifications- University degree or PhD in Computer Vision, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, Aerospace Engineering, Physics or a comparable discipline- Strong background jobs.description: Survivor Engagement and Case Management Coordinator (f/m/d) (80-100% / 32-40 hrs)in International Crimes and Accountability / Border Justice –Central Mediterranean ProjectCentral Mediterranean project in the International Crimes and Accountability team.Together with survivors, survivor-led organizations and partner lawyers, the project advancesaccountability for international crimes against people on the move (migrants, refugees andasylum seekers) in the Central Mediterranean and North Africa, including crimes committed inLibya and at sea. ECCHR offers psychosocial supervision facilitated bya trained psychosocial professional for staff undertaking this work.What the job includes Survivor outreach, support, and sustained communication: Identify, build andmaintain relationships with survivors, in close cooperation with survivor-ledorganizations and trusted partner networks. Support ongoing dialogue about survivors’priorities, legal options and opportunities for participation, and provide accessibleupdates throughout proceedings. Identify support needs together with survivors andcoordinate referrals, with their consent, to appropriate legal, psychosocial and otherservices. Develop and maintain referral arrangements and follow up within the agreedremit of the position. Case management and coordination: Take primary responsibility for coordinatingsurvivor contact and follow-up across the project’s cases. Maintain accurate, systematicand secure case records, including sensitive personal information, interviewdocumentation and potentially relevant evidence, while ensuring ongoing informedconsent, tracking agreed actions and deadlines, and respecting individualcommunication preferences, language requirements and security needs. Survivor-centred, trauma-informed interviewing: Conduct initial screeningconversations and tailored interviews to support survivors’ engagement in relevant legalproceedings, including assisting those who wish to apply for victim registration beforethe ICC. Work with colleagues and partner lawyers to document relevant experiences,respecting survivors’ choices and ongoing consent while minimizing avoidable distressand repeated recounting. Coordination with lawyers and justice mechanisms: Coordinate exchanges betweensurvivors and partner lawyers, including briefings and calls, and support proceduralfollow-up. Communicate with partner lawyers, the ICC’s Victims Participation andReparations Section (VPRS) and other relevant court sections and authorities, asappropriate, in coordination with the Central Mediterranean project lead. Interpreter and interview team coordination: Maintain and further develop anetwork of interpreters and translators in relevant languages. hearings, meetings and other relevant activities, including interpretation,travel and accessibility arrangements.Shared working methods: Strengthen procedures for survivor engagement and securecase management, working with colleagues across programs to ensure continuity andavoid unnecessary duplication of requests to survivors.What you bring Relevant practical experience working directly with people on the move, includingthose at risk or in insecure environments, and/or survivors of serious human rightsviolations, including sustained responsibility for individual cases and follow-up Demonstrated experience conducting trauma-informed interviews and documentingsensitive accounts for legal proceedings, human rights investigations or comparablepurposes A basic understanding of legal procedures and avenues for survivors’ access to justiceand participation, together with the ability to acquire detailed procedural knowledge andexplain complex information clearly Strong case management and organizational skills, including reliable documentation,coordination of multiple cases and consistent follow-through Practical understanding of survivor-centred approaches, including respect for individualautonomy, informed and ongoing consent, confidentiality and the right to declineparticipation Sound judgment concerning communication and security risks, including when workingremotely with people in precarious or changing circumstances Experience communicating across languages and working effectively with interpreters,including through telephone calls and messaging applications A commitment to working in partnership with survivor-led organizations andrecognizing survivors’ expertise and role in shaping accountability efforts An intersectional, power-critical approach: an understanding of how racism, gender,nationality, migration status, class, disability and other intersecting structures ofdiscrimination shape experiences of violence and barriers to justice Strong interpersonal skills, a collaborative approach while also able to workindependently, and the ability to build trusting relationships, maintain professionalboundaries and seek specialist input when needed Excellent spoken and written English Willingness to travel occasionally within and outside EuropeA law degree or professional legal qualification is an asset but not required. We welcomerelevant experience gained through professional, community-based and survivor-led work,alongside different educational and professional pathways.The following would be particularly valuable: Arabic language skills, particularly familiarity with Sudanese Arabic, would be asignificant asset. Other languages relevant to the communities we work with, includingFrench, Tigrinya, Amharic, Somali and Mandinka, are also welcome. Experience supporting survivor participation before the ICC, national criminal courts orregional and international human rights mechanisms Familiarity with the Central Mediterranean context, Libya, European borderexternalization or related accountability work Experience coordinating interpreters, interview teams or referral networksWe welcome applications from people of all cultures, backgrounds and experiences. jobs.description: ... part-time or full-timeMicroscopy, counting cells, solving challenging questions and identifying hidden pathogens: In our veterinary laboratory, you will make an important contribution to rapid diagnostics and, therefore, to providing our animal patients with the best possible care. As a veterinarian working alongside your doctoral position at another institution, you will work closely with our team, stay closely connected to the clinical environment and gain exciting insights into diagnoses and treatment courses. As rapid results are often essential in a clinical setting, you will also keep a cool head in demanding situations.If you are driven by a spirit of scientific curiosity, value precise work, would like to help animals and want to enrich our laboratory team with your veterinary expertise, we look forward to receiving your application for our in-house laboratory.Working in our laboratory offers you, as a veterinarian completing the professional recognition period, the opportunity to specifically apply the veterinary knowledge you have already acquired in the field of laboratory diagnostics while gaining an in-depth insight into clinical diagnostics and the resulting treatment decisions. You will work closely with experienced veterinarians and gain first-hand experience of how laboratory findings contribute to the assessment and care of our patients.The position is particularly aimed at veterinarians who have already completed their degree, have gained initial practical experience in veterinary laboratory diagnostics and would like to combine a position in our laboratory with their ongoing doctoral research at another institution for at least 12 months. In this role, you will combine your doctoral position with a professionally demanding position and have the opportunity to continuously deepen your knowledge in hematology, clinical chemistry, cytology, microscopy and other areas of laboratory diagnostics.Our modern laboratory enables comprehensive and rapid diagnostics around the clock, including at night and on weekends. Many test results are available within just 15 to 30 minutes and can be used immediately for diagnostics, treatment and intensive care.Our diagnostic spectrum includes, among other things, hematological and clinical chemistry analyses, blood gas and coagulation analyses, urinalyses, as well as rapid tests for infectious diseases and hormone determinations. Another focus is the microscopic examination and assessment of blood, urine and fecal samples, as well as cytological diagnostics of body cavity effusions, fine-needle aspirates and joint aspirates. Through close collaboration with our medical team, you will also gain a comprehensive insight into clinical contexts and can specifically further develop your veterinary knowledge.Your working hours will be distributed evenly between early and late shifts. Early shifts start at 7:30 a.m., while late shifts end at 8:00 p.m. In addition, you will work at least one weekend per month from 11:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.Please state in your cover letter your possible working hours and when you would be available to start working with us.CompensationAs a veterinary clinic, our compensation is based on our veterinary remuneration structures. jobs.employer_name: Apple Technology Engineering B.V. & Co. KG
jobs.description: SummaryImagine what you could do here. At Apple, new ideas quickly become extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences. Bring passion and dedication to your job, and there's no telling what you could accomplish. Smart people and inspiring, innovative technologies are the norm here.Our team is responsible for validating the RF performance of top-notch, monolithic, cellular transceivers and the RF subsystems built around them. In order to expand our team's validation capability towards future Apple products, we are looking for a passionate RF engineer with strong RF transceiver system understanding, complemented by AI/ML and programming skills. The world-class cellular RF sub-systems developed in our labs are enabling Apple mobile devices to deliver uncompromised cellular network connectivity at the lowest possible battery drain, enabling long hours of an enjoyable customer experience.Thus, join us and leverage your passion for RF excellence and innovation, bringing your advanced education and drive to the world's most innovative company!DescriptionIn the position of an experienced Receiver RF Silicon Validation Engineer, you will work on market-leading, cutting-edge cellular transceivers. The broad scope of responsibilities includes definition of test strategy and test plan creation derived from receiver system specification, characterization, and optimization of key RF parameters, the analysis of functional or performance issues encountered during different verification phases, and the development of scripts for test automation. You will work in an agentic engineering flow — scoping the problem and defining pass/fail criteria, delegating implementation and execution to AI agents, and verifying every result against the specification — applying innovative AI/ML-based methods to advance our measurement and analysis capabilities and to scale our regression environment. Your work style is very collaborative; you manage your deliveries and dependencies self-contained, and your execution enables you to meet your commitments.Minimum Qualifications- Master's degree or higher (PhD.) in Electrical Engineering, Communication/ Embedded Systems, or equivalent, paired with several years of industry experience- Experience with RF transceiver system definition and architecture, including RF impairments (e.g., I/Q imbalance, DC offset, phase noise, nonlinearity) and their impact on receiver performance — ability to derive validation strategy, test plans, and pass/fail criteria from system specifications- Advanced knowledge of 3GPP standards with a focus on RF transceiver aspects and receiver RF requirements- Working knowledge of AI/ML, able to apply AI/ML methods to achieve results, with a solid grasp of the fundamentals- Good programming skills, leveraging modern AI-coding assistants to generate scripts, debug logic, and optimize code, with languages such as Python, C/C++, and MATLAB- English language proficiency is required for this positionPreferred Qualifications- Hands-on experience applying AI/ML techniques and agentic engineering (delegating tasks to AI agents and verifying their output) to RF, signal-processing, or lab-automation problems is desirable- Hands-on experience (from PhD work, thesis, internships or industry) in characterizing and debugging RF cellular systems and components, including root cause analysis, and in creating test automation scripts to run in the lab and/or regression environment is beneficial - Ability to collaborate technically with a variety of teams (Design, Firmware, System, etc.) is essential- Team spirit, excellent communication skills, and the desire to accept diverse challenges are essential

jobs.occupation: Doctoral Researcher (f_m_x) - Forest Carbon Attribution from Earth Observation and Atmospheric Const (Geowissenschaftler/in)
jobs.description: The GFZ Helmholtz Centre for Geosciences is one of the world's leading institutions in the field of geosciences. As part of the Helmholtz Association, Germany's largest research organisation, we address global challenges such as natural hazards, climate change and the sustainable use of resources. In doing so, we combine cutting-edge research with social relevance. Our international staff - around 1,200 employees and approx. 500 guests - work in a multidisciplinary way and with a unique infrastructure to research the dynamic processes of the Earth system. Our vision: “Taking the pulse of the Earth to safeguard a habitable planet.”For section 1.4 Remote Sensing and Geoinformatics (https://www.gfz.de/en/section/remote-sensing-and-geoinformatics/overview) (department “Geodesy” (https://www.gfz.de/en/departments/geodesy) ), we are looking for a:Doctoral Researcher (f_m_x) - Forest Carbon Attribution from Earth Observation and Atmospheric ConstraintsReference Number 11590Many countries rely on forests to meet their climate targets, but how much of the forest carbon sink is real, and how much depends on management and disturbance, remains largely unverified. This PhD will combine satellite observations, carbon-cycle models, and atmospheric measurements to build an independent picture of forests’ actual role in the climate.This position is part of EUFOR-G3W, a Horizon Europe project contributing to the WMO Global Greenhouse Gas Watch (G3W). EUFOR-G3W develops observation- and model-based products to quantify greenhouse-gas sources and sinks at global to national scales.Within the EUFOR-G3W project, GFZ contributes to the development and application of harmonised Earth Observation (EO) datasets to improve our understanding of forest carbon dynamics. The research focuses on forest biomass, age, disturbance history, and vegetation productivity, as well as their integration into the FLUXCOM-X empirical flux upscaling framework to better represent managed and recovering forests.The successful candidate will investigate how forest management, disturbances, and recovery processes influence the land CO₂ budget across different spatial and temporal scales. A particular focus will be on combining satellite-based observations with carbon flux estimates and assessing how atmospheric observations can independently constrain these contributions.The candidate will be supervised by GFZ and Wageningen University and Research (WUR), (https://www.wur.nl/en) in collaboration with Max Planck Institut for Biogeochemistry (MPI-BGC) Jena (https://www.bgc-jena.mpg.de/en) . They will work closely with a second PhD candidate in the group of Wouter Peters at WUR, Netherlands. Together, the two positions form a duo linking observations and models: the GFZ position focuses on translating Earth Observation data into forest carbon information, while the WUR position focuses on forest and atmospheric modelling and data assimilation. Your research will have direct relevance to international climate policy: Your results will feed into operational greenhouse-gas monitoring systems supporting the WMO Global Greenhouse Gas Watch and the Copernicus CO2 monitoring service. You will have access to a unique combination of global forest EO datasets, cloud-native analysis infrastructure, forest ecosystem models, and atmospheric inversion systems. And you will be in close collaboration with leading European groups at WUR and MPI-BGC Jena within the EUFOR-G3W consortium.Your responsibilities:- Translate high-resolution EO forest datasets (e.g. biomass, forest age, disturbance) into model-ready inputs for forest and atmospheric models, while preserving key spatial information- Quantify the contribution of forest management and disturbance to forest CO2 exchange using model simulations constrained by EO data- Assess how well atmospheric CO2 observations can independently constrain this signal across regions and timescales- Contribute to improving the representation of managed and recovering forests in data-driven flux products such as FLUXCOM-X- Derive national forest carbon budgets and compare them with greenhouse-gas inventory reporting- Publish results in peer-reviewed journals and present at international conferences and project meetingsAbout You:Essential Qualifications:- An MSc in Earth Sciences, Environmental Sciences, Physical Geography, Atmospheric Sciences, Remote Sensing, or a related quantitative field- Strong quantitative and data analysis skills- Proficiency in Python and experience with geospatial or large environmental datasets- Good written and spoken English- Ability to work in a collaborative, multi-institutional research environmentDesirable Qualifications:- Experience in terrestrial carbon cycle science, ecosystem modelling, or Earth Observation of forests- Familiarity with atmospheric inverse modelling or greenhouse-gas accounting frameworks- Experience with Xarray, Dask, or cloud-based geospatial data analysis- Knowledge of national greenhouse-gas inventories or LULUCF accountingWe do not expect applicants to be already experts across all three disciplines — Earth Observation, forest modelling, and atmospheric inversions. The position is specifically designed to bridge them.Start date: 1st February 2027Fixed-term: 36 Monate (extension to 4 years possible, subject to funding)Salary: Die Stelle ist nach TVöD Bund mit der Entgeltgruppe 13 bewertet. Die Eingruppierung erfolgt nach den tariflichen Bestimmungen und den entsprechenden persönlichen Voraussetzungen.Working hours: Teilzeit 75% (derzeit 29,25 h/Woche)Place of work: PotsdamWhat we offer:- Ambitious and varied tasks in a dynamic and international research environmentState-of-the-art equipment- Public service benefits- Extensive training opportunities- Professional career advice offered by our in-house Career-Centre- Flexible working hours and conditions- Support with finding a good work-life balance offered by benefit@work- Institute day-care centre on sites- Working at the Albert Einstein Science Park on the Telegrafenberg in Potsdam- Workplace within walking distance of Potsdam main train station, or just a short ride on the shuttle busHave we piqued your interest?If so, we look forward to receiving your application by 2nd December 2026. Please use our online application form only.Required documents: CV including 3 bullet points on what excites you about this project, certificates & gradesThe GFZ actively promote diversity and equal opportunities. We explicitly welcome applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of ethnic and social origin, nationality, gender, sexual orientation and identity, religion/belief, age, and physical or neurodiverse abilities.“Diversity in perspectives” is one of GFZ's core values. As an integral part of supporting diversity at our centre, we actively promote women in science and in leadership positions. To know more about our Diversity policies, contact the diversity team. If you need more information about our gender equality policies, please do not hesitate to contact our Equal Opportunities Officer (https://www.gfz.de/en/career/the-gfz-as-an-employer/employee-representation) and check our Equal Opportunities Plan & Cascade Model (https://www.gfz.de/en/career/the-gfz-as-an-employer/equal-opportunities) .We look forward to applications from people who enjoy working in diverse teams, where everyone feels respected and valued and can fully develop their own talents. Applicants with severe disabilities and equalised persons will receive preferential consideration if equally qualified.Data protection information for applicants (https://www.gfz.de/en/career/job-offers#c95430)In case of any further queries regarding the field of activity, please contact Dr. Simon Besnard (besnard@gfz.de) via email. We work in agile teams, rely on transparent structures, and believe that excellence and innovation only emerge through true team spirit.Ready for your next step? Become part of IONOS and grow with us.NRE Operations runs the data center networks for the entire IONOS group: the physical fabric and underlay, the SDN overlay, and the virtual network functions on top, across dozens of data centers. We are looking for a senior or staff-level engineer who operates large production networks with a reliability mindset. You define what "healthy" means, catch problems before customers do, lead the hardest incidents, and partner with NRE Automation to push routine operations toward zero manual steps. AI is central to how we work, both to make the network smarter and to make each engineer faster.We expect every engineer here to be fluent with AI, and we mean it in two concrete ways. First, applying AI to the network itself: anomaly detection, automated diagnosis and root-cause analysis, config generation and validation, smarter alerting, and runbook or agent-driven automation. Second, using AI to raise your own output: coding assistants and LLM tooling for scripting, troubleshooting, research, and documentation. Reliability work punishes blind trust, so the skill that matters most is judgment. You need to know when an AI-generated config or diagnosis is trustworthy and when it is not.Tasks- Own reliability of the physical fabric, SDN overlay, and virtual network functions across all IONOS data centers. Set service level objectives and drive down unplanned downtime.- Lead incident response on major network incidents and run postmortems that produce lasting fixes.- Remove toil through automation, working with NRE Automation on pipelines and tooling for lifecycle, patching, and service configuration.- Apply AI to operations: anomaly detection, automated diagnosis, config generation and validation, and automated remediation, with the judgment to know when AI output is trustworthy.- Strengthen observability so problems surface before they reach customers, and shape lifecycle, upgrade, change-management, and capacity practices.- Collaborate with NRE Provisioning on clean handovers.- Share the on-call rotation covering the above.Qualifications- Extensive hands-on experience operating large-scale production data center networks (5+ years for Senior, longer for Staff).- Deep Layer 2 and Layer 3 knowledge: routing (BGP, OSPF) and VXLAN with BGP/EVPN.- Multi-vendor operations across Juniper and Cisco; SONiC and Netbox familiarity is a plus.- Strong Linux fundamentals and the toolkit that goes with them (bash, tcpdump, iptables, git).- Network automation you have built, using Python with Ansible and CI/CD on GitLab.- A reliability-engineering mindset: SLOs, observability, incident command, postmortems, designing out toil.- Fluent, critical use of AI in daily engineering, plus a track record or credible ideas for applying AI to network operations.- Fluent English for international teams; German is a plus. Ownership and a calm approach when things break.Benefits- Hybrid working model.- Flexible working hours through trust-based working hours.- At some locations a subsidized canteen and various free drinks.- Modern office space with very good transport connections.- Various employee discounts for activities and products.- Employee events such as summer and winter parties, as well as workshops.- Numerous training and development opportunities.- Various health offers, such as sports and health courses.

This section focuses on developing and operating infrastructure for gravity field observations from global to local scales, with applications spanning geodynamic and climatic processes, water budgets, and hazard monitoring.The PhD position is part of the ERC Synergy Grant Project "SnowShifts - Current and future shifts of snow regimes in extreme environments" (https://cordis.europa.eu/project/id/101224858) seeking to significantly enhance our comprehension of snow volume and mass, their non-linear dynamics and properties and, specifically, snow regime shifts within the Earth and climate systems. jobs.description: A Snapshot of Your Day You join a team that is being built right now. Transformation of Industry is setting up a dedicated Function Controlling for the first time, and you are part of it from the start. Headcount, external spend and project costs have moved, and the functional leadership team needs a clear view of the financial impact. You discuss the key drivers, challenge assumptions and agree on actions. Later, you prepare the monthly performance review, coordinate inputs with local controllers and work with colleagues on a more efficient reporting solution. You are close to the business, comfortable with detail and able to turn numbers into a concise management message.This is a rare moment to join. A new company is being built, and with it a new Finance organization: the central Business Controlling team of Transformation of Industry is developing into the Corporate FP&A department of that company, an organization of more than 100 finance professionals. knowledge of SAP, Power BI, SAC or comparable tools is a plus* Fluent English; additional languages are an asset but not requiredAbout the TeamOur Transformation of Industry division is decarbonizing the industrial sector. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. jobs.occupation: Failure Analysis Engineer, Electrical (m/w/d) Berlin, Germany (Qualitätsingenieur/in)
jobs.description: What to ExpectWe are looking for a Failure Analysis Engineer, Electrical, to join the failure analysis team in Berlin (Tesla Engineering Germany). This is an individual contributor role. You report to the mechanical failure analysis lead. The team finds root cause and contributing factors, so Tesla can reduce field, production, and development issues. You work with design, manufacturing, quality, and other engineering teams, across vehicle and energy products, including current models and products still in development. We need an electrical engineer with industry experience, not a new graduate, to identify and characterize electrical failures. You use a multimeter, an oscilloscope, and other basic electrical test equipment to confirm the symptom, isolate the fault, and support root cause with Design, Manufacturing, and Quality. The right person is comfortable on the bench: probing boards, reading a schematic well enough to troubleshoot, and explaining what they found. Manufacturing experience is a strong plus. That includes production test, yield, process, or factory debug.?What You’ll Do- Debug and troubleshoot analog and digital systems with a digital multimeter, oscilloscope, power supply, and related bench equipment. - Confirm and recreate failures seen in engineering, production, and the field. - Drive root cause from the first report toward a countermeasure, with the original design engineers and the other failure analysis engineers. - Use the analytical tools the case needs, including functional test, electrical debug, and X-ray. - Design experiments to test a theory, and run them yourself or with the technician. - Document findings and investigation status. Report root cause and the relevant facts to engineering and manufacturing. - Bring prior failure experience into design reviews and DFMEAs. - Partner with manufacturing on production and yield-related electrical issues that come into the lab.?What You’ll Bring- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience. - 1-3 years of industry experience in electrical debug, test, manufacturing, or a related hands-on role. This is not a new-graduate role. Internships and coursework alone are not enough. - Hands-on use of a digital multimeter and an oscilloscope, and experience with power supplies and other common electrical test equipment. - Able to read a schematic and troubleshoot analog and digital circuitry at a basic to intermediate level. - Strong written and spoken English. - Self-driven, structured, and comfortable in a fast-paced lab. - Preferred: experience with common failure analysis techniques. - Preferred: manufacturing experience (production test, yield debug, process engineering, or factory electrical troubleshooting). - Preferred: soldering and rework on PCBAs. - Preferred: familiarity with common digital protocols (I2C, CAN, LIN).?Tesla is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer committed to diversity in the workplace. jobs.description: What to ExpectWe are looking for a Failure Analysis Engineer to lead the failure analysis team in Berlin (Tesla Engineering Germany). This is the team lead. The electrical failure analysis engineer and the failure analysis technician report to you. The team finds root cause and contributing factors, so Tesla can reduce field, production, and development issues. You work with design, manufacturing, quality, and other engineering teams, across vehicle and energy products, including current models and products still in development. The role is hands-on. You own electromechanical failure analysis yourself, and you run the lab. You confirm and recreate failures, lead teardowns, and use optical microscopy, X-ray, and mechanical sample preparation to identify failure mechanisms. You report root cause and propose countermeasures with Design, Manufacturing, Quality, and the other failure analysis engineers. The right person has several years of industry experience, is comfortable taking assemblies apart and putting them back together, and can connect what they see under a microscope or on an X-ray to how the part was designed and built. A materials science background is preferred.?What You’ll Do- Lead the failure analysis team and laboratory. Manage operations, lab workflows, equipment, and the two people who report to you: the electrical failure analysis engineer and the failure analysis technician. - Drive failure analysis of electromechanical assemblies from the first report through root cause and countermeasure, including failure confirmation, recreation, and teardown inspection. - Use optical microscopes, 2D X-ray, and related inspection tools to characterize defects in mechanical and electromechanical hardware. - Prepare mechanical samples (sectioning, grinding, polishing) so failure interfaces can be inspected, and document what you find. - Disassemble and reassemble electromechanical assemblies while keeping the original form and function. - Design and run experiments to test a hypothesis, either yourself or with the technician. - Document inspections, replication tests, and teardowns in written reports, images, and the project tracking system. - Work with Design, Manufacturing, Quality, and suppliers on containment and corrective action. - Bring prior failure experience into design reviews and DFMEAs.?What You’ll Bring- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Materials Science, or equivalent experience. A materials science background is preferred. - 3-5 years of industry experience in failure analysis, reliability, product development, or a related hands-on engineering role. This is not a new-graduate role. - Hands-on experience with optical microscopes, X-ray inspection, and teardown of mechanical or electromechanical assemblies. - Able to take an assembly down to its subcomponents and explain what the parts are and how they work. - Able to fully disassemble and reassemble electromechanical assemblies without losing function or form. - Experience with mechanical sample preparation (saws, grinders, polishers) and with clear documentation: photos, optical images, and written reports. - Strong written and spoken English. Able to explain a failure mechanism clearly to design and manufacturing stakeholders. - Self-driven, structured, and comfortable in a fast-paced lab. - Preferred: tensile test, pressure or leak test, machine shop equipment, CAN or LIN, and oscilloscope.?Tesla is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer committed to diversity in the workplace. We are looking for a Senior Data Platform Engineer to join the Data Platform at Smartly!Smartly is building the standard path for governed data sharing across product services, analytics, and AI/ML. Avionics Technician (m/f/d)Parsdorf, Bavaria, GermanyMission Brief As an Avionics Technician within the AIT team, you will play a critical role in the final assembly, integration, and checkout of our launch vehicle's avionic and electromechanical systems. You will be responsible for routing and installing complex wire harnesses, integrating precision sensors and avionics units, and supporting critical test operations. This role requires a high degree of craftsmanship, working with both advanced composite and metallic structures, and operating safely around high-pressure and cryogenic fluid systems. Your Role in Our Space Mission: Key Responsibilities - Harness Routing & Installation: Route, secure, and install complex vehicle wire harnesses in accordance with engineering drawings and aerospace standards.  - Structural Bonding & Adhesives: Prepare surfaces and bond ClickBond clips and standoffs to metallic and composite structures. Apply aerospace-grade adhesives.  - Avionics Unit Installation: Install and mechanically secure telemetry modules, batteries, and other avionics enclosures. - Precision Mechanical Assembly: Use torque wrenches and calibrated hand tools to mate structural and electrical components, ensuring strict adherence to torque specifications and engineering drawings. - Crimping & Soldering: Perform high-reliability crimping, pinning, and soldering on flight connectors and wire splices.  - Rework & Modification: Execute precise rework and modifications on existing wire harnesses, connectors, and pinouts based on engineering change orders. - Sensor Installation & Checkout: Install and connect critical flight sensors (pressure transducers, thermocouples, RTDs, accelerometers, etc.) and verify functionality. - Fluid Connections: Install fluid lines using Swagelok fittings and components for instrumentation and purging systems. - Hazardous Operations Support: Work in close proximity to or directly interface avionics components with Cryogenic Liquid Oxygen (LOX) and Liquid Propellant (LPP) systems, adhering to strict cleanliness (oxygen clean) and safety protocols. - Electrical Checkouts: Utilize multimeters, megohmmeters, and specialized test equipment to perform continuity, isolation, and bonding checks. - **Testing & Troubleshooting: **Conducting integrated system testing and pre-launch checkouts alone or alongside test engineers Qualifications & Skills - Completed vocational training as an aircraft mechanic, specializing in avionics technician, maintenance technician or comparable training in accordance with the requirements  - Proven experience as an avionics, electrical, or electromechanical technician in aerospace, aviation, or high-reliability manufacturing. - Proficient with precision hand tools, calibrated torque wrenches, and electrical test equipment (multimeters). - Experience working on both carbon fiber/composite and aluminum aerostructures. - Strong knowledge of aerospace crimping, soldering, and harness manufacturing standards. - Ability to read and interpret complex electrical schematics, wire lists, and mechanical engineering drawings. - Ability to work in confined spaces and at heights. - Familiarity with safety protocols surrounding high-pressure gases and cryogenics. - High attention to detail and a strong commitment to flight safety and quality. jobs.description: A Snapshot of Your Day As an R&D Engineer for Power Transformers, you will play a crucial role in the power transformers development group. Your typical day will involve collaborating with a global development team to define and support technical rules and solutions. You will ensure the implementation of uniform and standardized components, enabling the delivery of sustainable engineering solutions efficiently and cost-effectively. Additionally, you will engage in various R&D projects within the Product Management organization and provide support to power transformer factories worldwide.How You’ll Make an Impact * Collaborate within a global R&D and factory network to drive innovation and support regional demands* Promote standardization and modularization programs while developing, improving, and implementing transformer design rules for specific applications* Assist regional factory sites and engineering teams with technical expertise and operational support* Contribute to the preparation of internal layouts, electrical clearances, magnetic distances, and routing of leads in the active part* Design supports and coordinate lead exits with winding assembly* Engage in various R&D projects to enhance product development and factory supportWhat You Bring* Bachelor’s degree in electrical or mechanical engineering* Longterm experience as a power transformer internal connections design engineer with long-term experience in mechanical design of transformers* Strong analytical skills with a systematic approach to complex problem-solving* In-depth knowledge and experience using PTC CREO for design (3D models, drawings, and bill of materials); advanced knowledge using CREO (relations, programming, MBD, etc.) is considered a plus* Excellent teamwork and collaboration skills* Good English language skills (written and spoken) are requiredAbout the TeamOur Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideoOur Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. Rewards/Benefits * In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs

Munich Re is one of the world's leading providers of reinsurance, primary insurance and insurance-related risk solutions. The group consists of the reinsurance and ERGO business segments, as well as the capital investment company MEAG. We are globally active and operate in all lines of the insurance business.Since our founding in 1880, we've been known for our unrivaled risk-related expertise and sound financial position. We offer customers financial protection when faced with exceptional levels of damage - from the 1906 San Francisco earthquake to the 2017 Atlantic hurricane season. The department works closely with integrated risk management, the business units and the regional organizations of Real Estate and Services to develop and implement risk-based measures and procedures and monitor their effectiveness.Within the newly established department we are looking for a Global Specialist Employee and Travel Security based in Munich.Your Job- Design and strengthen the global governance framework for employee and travel security- Establish harmonized standards, tools, and processes across regions- Manage and further develop external security providers at a global level- Define approval processes, travel risk models, and escalation mechanisms- Ensure a consistent and future-proof provider and outsourcing strategy- Collaborate closely with stakeholders across HR, Compliance, Risk Management and Corporate Security- Act as a trusted advisor during incidents and crisis situations affecting employees and operations- Drive continuous improvement through post-incident analysis and lessons learned- Support global awareness initiatives and build capabilities in travel and employee security- Provide up-to-date intelligence, travel advisories, and risk insights in a dynamic global environmentYour Profile- Degree in Security Management, Crisis Management, Business Continuity, Business Administration, or a comparable discipline- Relevant professional experience gained in executive protection, security operations or a related field- Strong understanding of risk assessment and travel security frameworks- Experience conducting protective intelligence and advance planning for travel and events- High level of precision, reliability, and responsibility- Structured, proactive, and solution-oriented working style- Strong communication skills across teams, cultures, and seniority levels- Ability to remain calm and effective in dynamic or challenging situations- Willingness to travel internationally- Strong professional proficiency in German and EnglishApplication InstructionsIn order to consider your application, we require your application to be submitted via our online applicant portal. In addition to uploading your CV, we recommend writing a cover letter to tell us more about why the position is of interest to you.About usAs the world's leading reinsurance company with more than 16,000 employees at over 50 locations, Munich Re introduces a paradigm shift in the way you think about insurance. By turning uncertainty into a manageable risk we enable fundamental change. Join us working on topics today that will concern society tomorrow, whether that be climate change, major construction projects, medical risk assessment or even space travel.Together we embrace a culture where multiskilled teams dare to think big. We create the new and the different for our clients and cultivate innovation.Sounds like you? Push boundaries with us and be part of Munich Re.Our employees are our greatest strength. That's why we offer them a wide range of benefits. Mission Brief The Chief Quality Inspector is the independent authority responsible for defining how product conformity is verified across manufacturing operations. This role establishes inspection strategies, verification methods, conformity assessment criteria, and competency standards to ensure objective evidence exists that every product meets defined requirements.The position is driving a quality-at-source culture and a scalable inspection framework capable of supporting company growth. The Chief Quality Inspector ensures inspection activities provide reliable product acceptance decisions and robust evidence of compliance throughout the manufacturing lifecycle.Your Role in Our Space Mission: - Define and govern the company inspection strategy, acceptance approaches, and verification methodologies.- Establish conformity assessment criteria and ensure objective evidence supports all product acceptance decisions.- Own inspection governance, standards, procedures, and inspection-related competency frameworks.- Lead laboratory functions including material testing, metallography, composite testing, calibration activities, and failure investigations.- Support process qualification activities by defining required verification and inspection evidence.- Drive implementation of quality-at-source principles across manufacturing operations.- Ensure inspection resources, technologies, and capabilities can scale with future production demand.- Develop and maintain inspector training, qualification, certification, and recertification requirements.- Partner with Manufacturing, Production Engineering, Product Assurance, and Supplier Quality to resolve conformity concerns and improve product quality.- Provide clear conformity recommendations and inspection performance reporting to senior leadership.Qualification Checklist - Extensive experience in manufacturing quality, inspection, product assurance, or quality engineering leadership roles.- Demonstrated expertise in inspection methods, conformity assessment, acceptance criteria, and verification planning.- Strong understanding of incoming inspection, in-process inspection, final inspection, and release processes.- Experience leading NDT disciplines including X-Ray, Computed Tomography (CT), Ultrasonic, and Dye Penetrant inspection.- Knowledge of laboratory operations, materials testing, metallography, calibration systems, and failure analysis methods.- Experience developing inspection standards, procedures, governance models, and competency frameworks.- Ability to make objective conformity decisions based on technical evidence and risk assessment.- Strong leadership capability with experience developing and managing multidisciplinary technical teams.- Proven ability to implement scalable quality systems within fast-growing manufacturing organizations.- Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and problem-solving skills.- Strong analytical mindset with high attention to detail and commitment to product integrity.- Professional proficiency in English; German language skills are advantageous.Aim high, deliver relentlessly, act with integrity, and keep the mission first.Benefits - Sport Clubs membership: Stay fit with our sponsored sports club memberships (EGYM Wellpass)- Individual learning allowance: Grow your skills with an individual learning budget granted after the probation period- Childcare allowance: Receive a childcare allowance for your non-school-age children- And Much More!
