At HelloFresh, our mission is simple: to change the way people eat, forever. As a global digital-native FMCG company and the world's leading mealkit provider, we are transforming the traditional food supply chain through a data-driven, on-demand model that enables scalable and more sustainable food delivery. The HelloFresh Group includes eight brands serving customers across multiple meal occasions, including HelloFresh, Green Chef, EveryPlate, and Chefs Plate, as well as ready-to-eat meals from Factor and YouFoodz, meat and seafood subscriptions through Good Chop, and pet nutrition with The Pets Table. Through technology, data, and culinary innovation, we deliver personalized food experiences to millions of households worldwide. The roleAs Head of Video, Berlin, you will shape how HelloFresh makes video for our international markets: the paid social engine, organic social, and our long-form YouTube content. Building and managing the team and systems behind all of it. You will lead the Berlin video team, including our international XPod, our fast and experimental content engine. Paid social is our biggest growth lever and the largest part of this role, but we do not want to lose the rest. Organic, long-form and brand storytelling all matter, and a strong Head of Video makes them work together. Whilst the scope is on our International market, we actively seek greater global collaboration. HelloFresh is at a pivotal moment of transformation. We are moving towards a modular, global content system, bringing AI-assisted workflows into how we plan, shoot and edit, and balancing centralised brand standards with local market needs. Berlin makes content for up to 14 markets that each need localisation, translation and cultural care, with local market teams who have a say on what ships. Our international XPod is a younger team than its New York counterpart, and part of your job is to bring it to the same standard, cadence and strategy.You will need to be as comfortable discussing channel metrics, spend and creative testing as you are discussing a script or a shot. You will partner closely with the Growth, Creative Strategy and Brand teams, with the XPod Director in North America, and with our Photo, AI, Culinary and Studio Operations teams, and you will have a real voice in how video works across the whole group.What you’ll doStudio Leadership & PeopleA strong video team is how we keep creative capability and institutional knowledge through a period of rapid change. You will lead, develop and inspire the Berlin video team, across XPod, organic social and long-form.- Set clear performance expectations, agree individual growth plans, and keep a healthy performance culture through regular 1:1s and honest, timely feedback.- Build and develop a team that spans producers, editors, creative strategists and post-production, and create career paths that keep talent with us.- Hire well, onboard well and keep the standard high as the team grows, including moving roles from freelance to full-time where it makes sense.- Create an open, supportive team culture where concerns are raised early and good ideas can come from anyone.Paid Social & PerformancePaid social is where we see the strongest return for the business. You will make international XPod a fast, reactive and experimental performance engine.- Deliver paid social content that performs, to brief, prioritised with the Growth and channel teams.- Run a clear test-and-learn rhythm across hooks, formats, creators and channels, and use performance data, including spend and cost per result, to decide what to make next.- Attend regular Growth meetings to align on performance, localisation, trends and channel spend, and turn what you learn into briefs and shoot plans quickly.- Build a lean creative strategy function inside the team that works hand in hand with Growth and Brand.- Bring Berlin XPod up to the cadence, tooling and strategy of our most mature XPod team, and share one way of working.Organic & Long-Form YouTubeWe want to keep investing in organic and long-form content alongside paid. Both build the brand and feed the paid engine.- Own the organic social video plan and grow it with the right talent, cadence and measures.- Lead our long-form YouTube content, currently focused on the UK, and develop it into a global proposition where the audience and the budget support it.- Make sure every long-form and organic shoot creates cut-downs, hooks and pickup shots that can serve paid, search and YouTube campaigns.- Keep the quality and storytelling of our brand video high, from short-form to long-form.Localisation & Modular ContentBerlin serves up to 14 markets, and doing that well is a core part of the role.- Build a modular approach: core shoots and footage libraries that adapt, with hooks and local elements changing by market.- Run localisation, translation and market adaptation as a managed, efficient process, with clear rules on what is shared and what is local.- Work with local market teams, who provide input on stories, formats and talent, to agree what is global and what is local without slowing delivery.- Establish batching and version control so one shoot creates many outputs, with clear naming, tagging and delivery.Production, Post-Production & WorkflowGood systems give creative people the room to do their best work.- Own the video workflow from brief through to casting, shooting, edit, localisation and final delivery.- Improve briefing standards, post-shoot reviews and production processes, so that learning builds up over time.- Work with Studio Operations, who own capacity planning, to schedule demand across brands and markets.- Make sure tools for tagging, metadata and asset management are used properly by every team that should be using them.- Create or expand our workflows for Influencer and Partnership content. AI & InnovationAI is changing how we plan, shoot, edit and version video. You will use it to amplify the team, not to replace its judgement.- Work with our AI team to decide where AI is the right tool: for versioning, editing and variants, and for what a shoot could not do practically.- Bring real shoots and AI-assisted work together in one workflow, with clear roles and honest communication about changes.- Test new formats, techniques and equipment, and show the results to creative and brand teams to widen what we can try.Delivery, Budget & Vendors- Own the video budget: forecast monthly and quarterly, allocate prudently and re-forecast as things change.- Manage vendors, agencies and freelancers, and brief them so that their output is useful across channels and markets, including paid.- Be accountable for on-time delivery and quality, and escalate delivery risks early with a recommendation.Cross-Functional Partnership- Partner closely with Growth, Creative Strategy, Brand, Studio Operations, Photo, AI and Culinary teams.- Work with the XPod Director in North America to align standards, learning and ways of working.- Be an ambassador for video across the company, building trusted relationships up to VP level.What you’ll bringYou are a senior video leader who combines real production craft with a deep understanding of paid social, and who loves content being made. You are as comfortable in a conversation about hooks, spend and cost per result as you are on set or in an edit.- Significant experience leading an in-house video or social content team in a high-volume, multi-brand environment.- Deep paid social knowledge: how creative performs on Meta, TikTok and YouTube, how spend and cost per result shape decisions, and how to run creative testing that changes what you make next.- A strong track record in organic social and long-form video, with a clear view of how they support paid and brand.- Proven experience managing multi-market content, including localisation, translation and working with local market teams.- Hands-on production and post-production knowledge, including how lighting, camera and edit decisions affect speed and quality, and a willingness to be on set.- Experience with AI-assisted workflows and a balanced view of where they help and where real production is better.- A record of developing people, building teams and managing change, with a decisive, calm and empathetic leadership style.- Credibility with senior stakeholders, including at VP level, across creative and commercial functions, and the confidence to say no with reasons.- A collaborative, respectful and proactive approach in an international team. Fluent English is required, and German is a plus.What we offerElevate your lifestyle! Join one of Europe's fastest-growing tech powerhouses in a dynamic phase of expansion.- Immerse yourself in a diverse global community of 90+ nationalities.- Enjoy a competitive compensation package that goes beyond the norm, with perks like a HelloFresh- subsidized Pension Scheme, Berlin relocation support, and a Hybrid working model.- Elevate your lifestyle with exclusive discounts on your weekly HelloFresh box and office meals.- Invest in your growth with an annual learning & development budget, German language learning budget, and access to the HelloFresh Academy.- Plus, we've got your well-being covered with mental health support, transportation perks, and working-parent-friendly benefits. From our 24/7 gym access,wellbeing platforms like Headspace and Spill, to sabbatical leave opErgänzende Informationen:Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach VereinbarungAnforderungen an den Bewerber: Expertenkenntnisse: Videobearbeitung, Video-Content, Gruppen-, Teamleitung

Experience in contract management? Interested in an international environment and renewable energies? Then we have the perfect opportunity for you!The CPX (Customer Project Execution) department is responsible for the project management of all wind farm projects from the start of the contract to completion. The team will take responsibility for a wind farm after the contract has been signed and will remain responsible until the final tests have been completed. Working closely with the logistics, procurement, and finance departments, the project team ensures that the project stays on budget and on schedule, and that our safety and quality standards are met. In addition, the project team works closely with the sales and legal departments to ensure that each wind farm delivers the highest energy yield within the customer specification.ResponsibilitiesContract management safeguards Vestas' commercial interests during the construction phase of new wind farms. During this phase, we take on core tasks and support the project team with proactive and constant advice and recommendations on commercial and contractual issues related to the implementation of a project in terms of safety, quality, time and budget. For individual construction projects, Contract Management provides direct contract management support to the project team. The Contract Manager also ensures coordination with internal departments, including the legal and financial departments, sales and bid management. Your tasks will include:- Commercial and contractual support during the construction phase of new wind farms, including advising internal stakeholders on turbine supply contracts- Enforcing claims against clients and subcontractors as well as conducting negotiations with these parties- Ensuring compliance with internal processes in the creation, filing and documentation of correspondence and records- Responsibility for claims management, including assessment of potential damage scenarios, derivation of recommendations and writing formal letters- Contribution to risk management (ONS) through identification and assessment of contractual risks- Capture and analyze contract-related insights to help optimize and evolve contract structures- Working closely with internal stakeholders and management to ensure effective implementation of contractual obligationsQualifications- Academic degree in law or business law (Bachelor's, Master's or Diploma)- At least 4 years of professional experience in drafting, reviewing, negotiating and managing contracts- Sound knowledge of construction and energy contracts, preferably with experience in power plant projects (FIDIC or EPCI is an advantage) is an advantage- Language skills: Fluent in German and English, both oral and writtenCompetencies- Strong methodological, analytical and problem-solving skills as well as a structured, independent way of working- Ability to work in a team, intercultural understanding and very good communication skills at all levels – internally and externally- Willingness to travel of up to 20%Your benefits – because your commitment counts! - Start & Perspective: Structured onboarding program and a permanent employment contract with long-term prospects - Development & Experience: Varied work in a forward-looking industry and individual opportunities for professional growth - Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Overtime account, option to work from home up to 8 days per month, Extra days off on Christmas Eve and New Year's Eve, and the option for a sabbatical - Add-Ons: Business bike, gym allowance, company pension plan, Germany-wide train ticket (Deutschlandticket) - Team & Culture: Scandinavian-inspired with flat hierarchies, informal culture, and team spirit

You work in the lab and at the test bench — hands-on, in a team, with real space hardware every day.Your tasks in detail:- Prepare and post-process the testing areas: You set up test benches and specimens, tear down after tests, and keep the testing area ready for action. → High Performance: The test bench is ready when the team needs it.- Run and document tests: You support destructive testing and acceptance testing (NDT) and record every step cleanly. → Accountability: What was tested is documented. jobs.occupation: Rare Disease Manager (Key Account Manager) for NF1, Middle East of Germany (all genders) (Biologe/Biologin)
jobs.description: Work Your Magic with us!Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.United As One for Patients, our purpose in Healthcare is to help create, improve and prolong lives. We develop medicines, intelligent devices and innovative technologies in therapeutic areas such as Oncology, Neurology and Fertility. Our teams work together across 6 continents with passion and relentless curiosity in order to help patients at every stage of life. Joining our Healthcare team is becoming part of a diverse, inclusive and flexible working culture, presenting great opportunities for personal development and career advancement across the globe.Your Role: As a Rare Disease Manager (Key Account Manager) for Neurofibromatose Typ 1 (NF1) , you will be at the heart of transforming how patients with rare diseases access life-changing therapies — your work directly influences treatment pathways and outcomes for some of the most underserved patient populations. You will own your territory like a true entrepreneur, taking full accountability for strategy, execution, and sustainable business growth across hospitals, treatment centers, and referral networks. You will develop and execute customized strategic account plans that strengthen centers of excellence, optimize referral pathways, and accelerate time-to-treatment for patients in need. Building deep, trust-based partnerships with physicians, nurses, pharmacists, and multidisciplinary teams will be your daily currency — and you will do it with scientific credibility and genuine care. Leveraging your deep scientific expertise, you will engage healthcare professionals as a peer and trusted partner, translating complex clinical evidence into meaningful conversations that drive better standards of care. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional colleagues in Medical Affairs, Market Access, Marketing, and Commercial teams to align strategies and maximize impact across the healthcare ecosystem. Data is your compass: you will use CRM tools, market analytics, and territory business planning to identify opportunities, monitor performance, and continuously refine your approach. You will champion disease awareness and patient education initiatives, playing a key role in shaping the rare disease landscape in your region. Acting as the voice of the customer, you will bring actionable field insights back to the organization — directly influencing strategy at a national level. This is a rare opportunity to combine commercial excellence with genuine patient impact — if that drives you, this role was made for you.Your territory covers key hubs across the Middle East of Germany — mainly Dresden, Leipzig and Göttingen area — and ideally, you already call one of these regions home.Who You Are:- You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Biology, Chemistry, Pharmacy, Medicine, or a related life science field; a qualification as Pharmaceutical Representative per local regulatory requirements is a plus.- You bring at least 4–5 years of commercial experience in the pharmaceutical, biotech, or healthcare industry, with a proven track record in strategic account management and market development.- You have hands-on experience in rare disease environments and a strong understanding of the complex stakeholder dynamics involved.- You possess deep knowledge of healthcare systems, reimbursement pathways, and patient access processes, ideally with exposure to high-cost specialty therapies.- You are scientifically agile — able to engage with complex clinical data and translate it into compelling, compliant customer discussions.- You combine an entrepreneurial mindset with strong analytical capabilities, taking ownership of results and thriving in ambiguous, fast-evolving environments.- You are a skilled communicator and relationship builder, experienced in working across cross-functional teams and navigating complex stakeholder landscapes.- You are fluent in German and English and highly willing to travel within your territory, including overnight travel as required.- A valid driving license is required.What we offer: We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!

jobs.occupation: Senior Data Expert with focus on Policy & Compliance (m/f/d) (Bioinformatiker/in)
jobs.description: At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections,  where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.The PositionAt Roche, we are passionately committed to improving the lives of patients. This is what motivates us to come to work every day. We are dedicated to scientific rigor, uncompromising ethical principles, and ensuring access to medical innovation for all. Through our work today, we strive to create a better future.Advances in AI, data, and computational sciences are transforming drug discovery and development. Roche’s Research and Early Development organizations at Genentech (gRED) and Pharma (pRED) have demonstrated how these technologies can accelerate R&D. Seamless access to trustworthy, well governed data across gRED and pRED is essential to realizing these opportunities.Within the Computational Sciences Center of Excellence, Data & Digital Catalysts modernizes our computational and data ecosystems and integrates digital technologies across Research and Early Development. The Data Capability helps scientists find, understand, access, and use data responsibly and efficiently.Your Key ResponsibilitiesJoin the Computational Sciences Center of Excellence as a Senior Data Expert, Policy & Compliance (m/f/d) in the Compliance by Design team. You will make responsible data and AI use workable in scientific R&D by translating legal, regulatory, contractual, and internal policy requirements into clear decisions, guidance, and processes. Based in Penzberg, you will combine strong local scientific partnership with work across pRED and gRED, and lead matrixed project teams to improve how data is governed, accessed, reused, and prepared for computational use. In doing so, you will take on the following exciting tasks:* You will plan, contribute to, and in certain cases lead policy, compliance, and data governance projects of increasing complexity. Furthermore, we may ask you to lead matrixed project teams involving scientific, data, technology, and compliance stakeholders to coordinate the outcome from scope to implementation. * Most importantly, you are the one to translate legal, regulatory, contractual, and internal policy requirements into practical requirements for scientific and data workflows. In this translational process you will design workable processes and controls and support the respective implementation and adoption.* You will act as a subject matter expert in one or more relevant areas, e.g. scientific data quality, data lifecycle management, data governance or AI and data policy* It will be up to you to build trusted relationships with scientific and data stakeholders in Penzberg and across pRED and gRED. You will also represent scientific needs in broader policy, governance, and technology initiatives so that resulting solutions are both compliant and workable.* You will identify material compliance, data quality, and operational risks in complex or ambiguous situations. This may also include the development of pragmatic recommendations and mitigation approaches to bring unresolved decisions to the appropriate owner.* You will also develop and improve methods for assessing data quality and policy compliance and create reusable implementation resources. jobs.description: Job available in 4 locations: Berlin, Halle, Remote, LeipzigWork ScheduleStandard (Mon-Fri)Environmental ConditionsOfficeJob DescriptionJob DescriptionAs part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.The Clinical Diagnostics Division (CDD) provides innovative diagnostic solutions across selected in vitro diagnostics (IVD) market segments and has been a trusted partner to the IVD industry for more than 40 years.Our portfolio includes solutions for drugs-of-abuse testing, therapeutic drug monitoring, quality control, sepsis diagnosis, prenatal screening and more. In addition, CDD offers advanced laboratory instrumentation and high-throughput automation solutions for a wide range of clinical laboratory environments.Our products and solutions are delivered through direct sales, regional distributors and OEM partnerships.Location:Field-based / Remote within the territory - Eastern/ Central GermanyIdeally based in e.g. Halle, Leipzig or BerlinDiscover Impactful WorkJoin our Clinical Customer Development team as a Clinical Customer Development Specialist and support the targeted clinical use of Procalcitonin (PCT) and other innovative biomarkers.In this field-based role, you will lead clinical market development across your territory and increase awareness, acceptance and sustainable adoption of our biomarkers through targeted engagement with healthcare professionals, clinical education and development activities. In doing so, you will support the diagnosis and management of bacterial infections and sepsis, as well as antimicrobial stewardship initiatives, and contribute to advancing biomarker-guided clinical decision-making.You will take ownership of clinical market development within your territory, with the goal of increasing demand, acceptance and sustainable clinical adoption of our biomarkers. Your focus will be on clinical education, stakeholder engagement and account development, while commercial contracting and sales execution remain with our License Partners.A Day in the Life:You will lead clinical account development across hospitals and healthcare institutions within your territory and build strong, sustainable relationships with clinicians, laboratory professionals and healthcare decision-makers in areas such as Internal Medicine, Paediatrics, Infectious Diseases, Emergency Medicine, Critical Care and Antimicrobial Stewardship teams.You will identify the objectives and clinical challenges of healthcare professionals and translate these insights into targeted educational and development activities. This includes supporting the implementation of biomarker-guided clinical pathways, hospital protocols and antimicrobial stewardship programs, as well as delivering clinical education through discussions, presentations and workshops.What to expect:- Drive clinical demand and adoption of Procalcitonin (PCT) and other innovative biomarkers.- Engage healthcare professionals, clinical users and decision-makers across relevant medical specialties.- Analyze and prioritize accounts with high clinical development potential, identify relevant stakeholders and develop account-specific strategies to increase clinical acceptance and adoption.- Build strong, sustainable relationships with key clinical stakeholders and decision-makers.- Support the implementation of biomarker-guided clinical pathways, hospital protocols and antimicrobial stewardship programs.- Deliver clinical education through discussions, presentations and workshops.- Develop account strategies together with our License Partners, align clinical development activities and support joint customer activities where appropriate.- Act as a scientific and clinical partner and actively drive market development without direct sales responsibility.- Work closely with Medical Affairs, Marketing and other Commercial teams.- Represent Thermo Fisher Scientific at relevant events and scientific congresses.- Contribute to territory growth through increased clinical adoption and systematic account development.Ensure complete and up-to-date documentation of relevant account and activity information in Salesforce (SFDC).Keys to Success:Education- Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Chemistry, Biology or a related scientific field; an advanced scientific or clinical degree is an advantage.Experience- 3+ years of relevant experience in healthcare, diagnostics or a related environment.- Experience in in vitro diagnostics, biomarkers, or clinical areas such as Critical Care, Infectious Diseases, Emergency Medicine, sepsis or Antimicrobial Stewardship is an advantage.- Experience engaging clinical users and healthcare decision-makers.Knowledge, Skills, Abilities- Ability to understand and communicate scientific and clinical content.- Strong communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills.- Confident and persuasive engagement with medical decision-makers at different seniority levels, with the ability to conduct credible clinical discussions, constructively challenge established approaches and initiate change.- Strong analytical and organizational capabilities.- Strong initiative, influencing skills and results orientation, with the ability to identify clinical development opportunities early and systematically advance them.- Ability to build lasting relationships with clinical stakeholders and business partners.- Ability to work independently and effectively in a cross-functional matrix organization.- Proficiency with CRM systems, preferably Salesforce, and Microsoft Office.- Valid driver’s license and willingness to travel extensively within the assigned territory (>50%).- Fluent German and strong English communication skills.Benefits:We offer competitive remuneration, annual incentive plan bonus, healthcare, and a range of employee benefits. Thermo Fisher Scientific offers employment with an innovative, forward-thinking organization, and outstanding career and development prospects. We offer an exciting company culture that stands for integrity, intensity, involvement, and innovation!Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Watch as our colleagues explain 5 reasons to work with us. As one team of 100,000+ colleagues, we share a common set of values - Integrity, Intensity, Innovation and Involvement - working together to accelerate research, solve complex scientific challenges, drive technological innovation and support patients in need.#StartYourStory at Thermo Fisher Scientific, where diverse experiences, backgrounds and perspectives are valued.Apply today! http://jobs.thermofisher.com (http://jobs.thermofisher.com/)Thermo Fisher Scientific is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of  , color, religion, ___ ,   orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status.

The Molecular Cell Biology research group at the University of Tübingen is looking for a motivated PhD candidate (DFG project 65% TVL) to work on the project:The role of mtDNA copy number for cell function and dysfunction Our research: How do cells coordinate metabolism, growth and cell division?In the model organism budding yeast we investigate how cellular signaling ensures that biochemistry and physiology of the cell are coordinated. See our webpage for details: www.uni-tuebingen.de/molcellbioThe PhD candidate will investigate how mitochondrial DNA affects cell physiology and fitness on a single cell and population level. The broad method spectrum will include quantitative phenotyping by live-cell microscopy, yeast genetic screens, and “omics” with our facilities. The candidate will work in close collaboration with the Dr. Kurt Schmoller lab at the Helmholtz München. Who should apply? We are looking to fill the position in early 2027, but the start date is flexible. Our work is interdisciplinary so we can accommodate candidates with various life science backgrounds. Basic experience in experimental molecular biology is required, basic programming skills are a plus. Our lab language is English. Your application should include a CV, transcripts, brief and specific motivation letter, (preliminary) abstract of your Master thesis, and names of at least two references.Please combine into a single pdf and send by email.Deadline is Dec 8th. This project is initially DFG-funded for three years at 65% E13 TVL payscale, extension for a fourth year is anticipated. We are a multidisciplinary and international team with a very supportive work environment.The University of Tübingen is an equal opportunity employer. Disabled candidates will be given preference over other equally qualified applicants. The University seeks to raise the number of women in research and teaching and therefore urges qualified women to apply. The appointment is facilitated by the central administration.

jobs.description: About usAirbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.Job descriptionIn order to support our development of the cold spray process for deposition of Aluminum layers, Airbus Defence and Space offers aPhD-position on Multiscale Simulation of Cold Gas Spraying Processes for the Prediction of Repair Quality (d/f/m)Are you looking for a PhD Thesis topic in material science and engineering? Then apply now! We look forward to you joining us at Airbus Central Research & Technology.- Location: Taufkirchen/Ottobrunn- Start: as soon as possible- Duration: 36 monthsCold Gas Spraying (CGS) has established itself as a promising process for the repair of metallic components in safety-critical applications. The quality of the repair depends significantly on complex physical phenomena – such as particle deformation, interface bonding, oxide film disruption, and local thermomechanical effects. A deep understanding of these processes is crucial to ensure the structural integrity and long-term stability of the repaired components.Currently, however, there is a lack of a validated simulation approach that combines in-depth physical insights with long-term applicability in industrial development processes. Various numerical methods – from continuum-based to particle-based approaches – have already made valuable contributions to understanding local process phenomena such as plastic deformation, adiabatic heating, and interface formation in research.This doctoral thesis aims to develop a holistic simulation framework that represents these physical effects across multiple scales. The goal is to create a robust, interpretable, and sustainably usable model that can simulate both single-particle interactions and macroscopic coating build-up scenarios under realistic process conditions.The focus lies on methods based on software platforms that are established in industrial environments, available in the long term, and widely maintained. At the same time, supplementary investigations using alternative approaches (e.g., particle-based methods such as SPH or DEM) may be conducted in a research context to deepen insights or validate model assumptions.Your locationOur site is just a stone's throw away from Munich, the beautiful capital of Bavaria. Are you into sports and other outdoor activities? The Alps and Lake Starnberg are within an hour’s reach, offering a multitude of recreational options.Your benefits- Attractive salary and work-life balance with a 35-hour week (flexitime).- Traveling to Airbus sites and overseas (conferences).- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.- Work with modern/diversified technologies.- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.Your tasks and responsibilities- Analysis of the state of the art in numerical methods for simulating Cold Gas Spraying processes, with a focus on continuum mechanics approaches (Lagrange, Euler, CFD).- Development and validation of simulation models to describe particle-substrate interaction, including plastic deformation, adiabatic heating, and interface formation.- Modeling of damage mechanisms such as incomplete oxide disruption, delamination, or local crack initiation.- Coupling of CFD and solid body simulation models for a holistic representation of the process (optional).- Integration and correlation of simulation results with experimental data from accompanying projects (e.g., microstructure, process monitoring).Desired skills and qualifications- Completed university master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aeronautical Engineering, Computational Mechanics, Materials Science, or a related engineering or natural science field.- Solid knowledge in solid mechanics, plasticity theory, and numerical methods (FEM, CFD).- Experience with simulation software (e.g., Abaqus, ANSYS, LS-DYNA).- Basic understanding of coating processes or additive manufacturing technologies.- Analytical thinking and the ability to model complex physical relationships.- Creative problem-solving skills and an innovative mindset.- Structured, self-reliant work style and enthusiasm for interdisciplinary research.- Programming skills (Python, Fortran, C++) for the automation and scripting of simulation runs are an advantage.- Very good English skills in writing and speaking, good German skills.Please upload the following documents: cover letter, CV, relevant transcripts, enrollment certificate.Not a 100% match? jobs.occupation: Expert SAP S/4HANA Cloud Environment Engineer (f/m/d) (Büroassistent/in)
jobs.description: Join our Community of SolversWe are looking for a Expert SAP S/4HANA Cloud Environment Engineer (f/m/d) to join our Business Services (https://jobs.pwc.de/de/de/interne-dienstleistungsbereiche)  division starting from March 2026.Your responsibilitiesResponsibility – As a part of the Product & Technology team, you will deploy and configure SAP BTP services. You will cooperate with business analysts, developers, and deployment teams to prevent and resolve technical issues, ensuring integration and optimization across platforms.Automation - You support the automation tools from SAP BTP (e.g. Build Process Automation) and drive continuous improvement with additional suitable tools. You implement security measures, ensure compliance, and engage stakeholders with clear, focused communication.Solutions – You define guidelines, standards, and manage infrastructure to deliver and maintain SAP S/4HANA-based processes and solutions, ensuring end-to-end integration and optimization within the cloud environment.Innovations – You assess emerging cloud technologies, evaluate SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud and SAP BTP innovations, and drive continuous improvement by leveraging tools for automation and efficiency.Your profile- You have completed your studies in computer science, economics, or a comparable field.- You bring several years of experience in SAP BTP management and SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud integrations.- You have in-depth knowledge of modern technologies such as cloud management platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud) and infrastructure-as-code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or Ansible.- You have in-depth knowledge of modern technologies such as cloud management platforms, especially SAP Business Technology Platform- You have extensive experience in configuring and optimizing SAP BTP to SAP S/4HANA integrations.- You are fluent in English and German both spoken and written.- Your analytical, independent, and structured approach to work supports you defining guidelines. Furthermore, your communication enables effective collaboration with various teams.Your benefitsFlexibility – We encourage you to choose your working hours and your working place the way that suits you and your lifestyle. We do not have core working hours and we also offer you the possibility of home office or temporary work from abroad. Always in accordance with operational requirements and labor law regulations. Career Development – We are passionate about your personal and professional development, therefore we offer your regular training with our internal Academy, international experiences by doing a secondment and continuous mentoring on the job. Also, we support you on finding suitable external trainings and further education programmes. Lifestyle – You can accumulate overtime on your annual working time account (JAZ) and compensate for it with time off after busy periods. Any remaining overtime is paid out once a year. You also have 30 days of vacation per calendar year.Health and Wellbeing – Your health is important to us: in addition to our own company health insurance scheme, we also offer preventive medical check-ups and divers sport offerings. Take part in our free company sports programme or benefit from reduced rates at various gyms or an Urban Sports Club membership.And there is even more – It is our purpose to create a positive working environment: An environment where flexible and creative working is possible, where work is recognized and performance is rewarded and of which we are all very proud. You can find more detailed information on all of our benefits on our career website.At PwC Germany, it is our purpose to solve our clients' key challenges, create sustainable outcomes and build trust in business and society. As part of our internal IT team (Products & Technology), you are the driver behind our promise: human-led and tech-powered. We are experts for our technology solutions and make the use of technology easier and more efficient. As a team, we develop innovative solutions for the entire product life cycle and manage the use of technology in the organization. Drive the technological development of PwC Germany in our diverse teams!ContactIf you have any questions about this position or your application, please reach out to Patricia Weiss at +49 69 9585-2222.

About UsWhat if your work could drive change in a globally established industry, shaping processes that touch every corner of the world? At Forto, we are at the forefront of change, harnessing the power of AI to revolutionise logistics. We want to reinvent digital supply chains to be transparent, frictionless and sustainable. From day one, our mission has been to simplify global trade – creating a seamless and efficient logistics process.About the roleAt Forto, the sales pipeline starts with you. As a Sales Development Representative (f/m/d), your job is to open doors with high-potential customers, and book qualified meetings for our Sales Managers. You’ll become an expert on our customers, outreach strategy, and value proposition, while helping drive growth across Germany. This is a high-impact, high-visibility role for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys dealing with people, and wants a launchpad into a career in Sales.Key Responsibilities- Generate pipeline: Identify, research, and engage with ideal customer profiles across all outbound channels (e.g., cold calls, emails, LinkedIn). Think creatively and test new approaches to spark engagement.- Book qualified meetings: Own the top of the funnel. Schedule high-quality discovery meetings for Sales Managers – enabling them to uncover customer needs and tailor our value proposition.- Maintain CRM hygiene: Accurately record all prospecting activities, lead qualifications, and appointment details in our CRM (Salesforce).- Test and learn: Share insights from the field – objections, messaging, tactics – with Sales and Marketing to refine our go-to-market strategy.Required Skills and Experience- 1+ years in Sales, with a proactive, confident approach to outreach (esp. cold calling)- Native level (C2) fluency in German and good English, with strong written and verbal communication skills- Resilient self-starter who’s curious, motivated, and eager to grow- Strong organizational and time-management skillsPreferred Skills and Experience- Experience in Logistics, Supply Chain, or SaaS sales- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Logistics, or a related fieldDon’t fit all of our criteria? That’s okay! We know that you might be hesitant to apply if you don’t meet all our requirements, but here at Forto, we pride ourselves on embracing diverse perspectives and celebrating potential. If you are passionate about this position and the Forto values, please apply anyway. There could be a place for you in this role – or another one that’s a perfect fit! Why work with us?Our team is hard-working, constantly seeking to maximise the impact of their work, but we put our people first, always winning with care. jobs.occupation: Team Lead Group Reporting & General Ledger (f/m/d) (Betriebswirt/in (Hochschule) - Steuern und Prüfungswesen)
jobs.description: About UsWhat if your work could drive change in a globally established industry, shaping processes that touch every corner of the world? At Forto, we are at the forefront of change, harnessing the power of AI to revolutionise logistics. We want to reinvent digital supply chains to be transparent, frictionless and sustainable. From day one, our mission has been to simplify global trade – creating a seamless and efficient logistics process.About the roleAs Team Lead Group Reporting & General Ledger, reporting to the Head of Accounting, you’ll lead the team that owns Forto’s general ledger, IFRS consolidated financial statements, and HGB statutory accounts. You’ll partner closely with FP&A, Corporate Finance & Investor Relations, Tax, Treasury, and our external auditors to deliver accurate, timely, and compliant reporting across the group.Key Responsibilities- Lead, coach, and develop the team, fostering a culture of accuracy, ownership, and continuous improvement.- Ensure general ledger integrity across all entities, including the chart of accounts, journal entry review, accruals, and balance sheet reconciliations.- Own Forto’s group close (monthly, quarterly, and year-end) and consolidation, including intercompany reconciliations, eliminations, and FX translation.- Prepare the monthly IFRS consolidated financial statements and notes, and the annual HGB single-entity financial statements for the German entities and management reports.- Lead the annual audits (local and Group) as the main point of contact for our external auditors.- Assess complex and non-routine transactions (e.g., IFRS 16 leases, IFRS 15 revenue and cost recognition, IFRS 9 financial instruments, IFRS 2 share-based payments) and prepare technical accounting memos.- Lead the IFRS 18 implementation, effective from 1 January 2027.- Maintain group accounting policies and the reporting manual.Required Skills and Experience- 8+ years experience in group reporting, general ledger accounting, consolidation, or audit, including 2+ years leading a team of accounting professionals.- A degree in Accounting or Finance, and a professional accounting qualification (e.g., or Wirtschaftsprüfer/Bilanzbuchhalter, CPA, ACCA, CA).- In-depth IFRS and solid HGB knowledge, with the ability to turn standards into practical guidance.- Experience running a multi-entity close, preparing consolidated financial statements, and managing external audits.- Experience with ERP and consolidation systems (e.g., LucaNet, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central) and advanced Excel skills.- A structured, detail-oriented, hands-on approach and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, scaling environment.- Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex accounting topics to non-finance audiences.- Ability to manage several stakeholders at the same time, especially during closing processes- Actively and continuously searching for improvements of our financial processes- Fluent written and verbal English and German.Preferred Skills and Experience- Experience in logistics or a fast-paced tech company.- Experience using automation or AI to improve finance processes.- Experience in modeling financial solutions (e.g. in regard to the valuation of options, ECL-assessments).Don’t fit all of our criteria? That’s okay! We know that you might be hesitant to apply if you don’t meet all our requirements, but here at Forto, we pride ourselves on embracing diverse perspectives and celebrating potential. If you are passionate about this position and the Forto values, please apply anyway. There could be a place for you in this role – or another one that’s a perfect fit! Why work with us?Our team is hard-working, constantly seeking to maximise the impact of their work, but we put our people first, always winning with care. We value efficient systems and swift, direct communication. We want everyone to have their time to speak, so that we can embrace diverse perspectives to help drive towards solutions always.Ergänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Grundkenntnisse: Buchführung, Buchhaltung, Kundenberatung, -betreuung, Berichtswesen, Information

jobs.occupation: Senior Manager AWS Cloud & AI Strategy (w/m/d) (Unternehmensberater/in)
jobs.description: Join our Community of SolversWe are looking for a Senior Manager AWS Cloud & AI Strategy (f/m/d) to join our** Consulting (https://jobs.pwc.de/de/de/consulting-solutions) **division starting at the earliest possible opportunity.Your responsibilitiesStrategy – You translate executive business priorities into cloud, GenAI and Agentic AI transformation roadmaps and help clients define their future business and operating models.Transformation – You develop business cases, target operating models and transformation blueprints, while driving process redesign and operating model transformation enabled by Agentic AI.Growth – You collaborate with technical teams to define integrated end-to-end cloud and AI solutions and drive strategic AWS pursuits.Leadership – You shape compelling AWS and AI transformation narratives for C-level stakeholders, influence strategic decision-making, build trusted executive relationships and drive business-led transformation from strategy to execution.Your profile- You have successfully completed a degree in Business Administration, Economics, Technology Management, Computer Science, or a comparable field.- You bring 6-10 years of professional experience in strategy consulting, business transformation, and/or technology strategy, including the development of business cases, operating models and executive-level programs.- You possess deep AWS expertise combined with strong executive advisory capabilities and can translate complex business requirements across cloud, GenAI and Agentic AI into scalable solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes.- You have a proven track record of acting as a trusted advisor to senior client executives, driving strategic initiatives from initial concept through implementation and orchestrating collaboration across business and technology teams.- You communicate confidently in English and German, combine a collaborative and hands-on approach with a strong enthusiasm for GenAI and emerging technologies to turn innovative ideas into tangible client value.Your benefitsFlexibility – In coordination with your team, you can expect a mix of working in the office and home office. There are no core working hours – within the scope of operational requirements and legal regulations, you can organize your working hours flexibly. In addition, you have the opportunity to work temporarily in over 40 countries.Family – Working parents bring huge value to our firm and we want to ensure that they are supported at every stage and feel confident balancing their work and home lives. Also, we support you, If required, in caring for relatives by arranging carers, special leave or part-time models.Lifestyle – You can accumulate overtime in your flex-time account and compensate for it with time off after busy periods. A partial payout is possible once a year. We will be happy to discuss the exact details with you in a personal meeting. You also have 30 days of vacation per calendar year.Health and Wellbeing – Your health is important to us: in addition to our own company health insurance scheme, we also offer preventive medical check-ups andAnd there is even more – It is our purpose to create a positive working environment: An environment where flexible and creative working is possible, where work is recognized and performance is rewarded and of which we are all very proud. You can find more detailed information on all of our benefits on our career website.At PwC Germany, it is our purpose to solve our clients' key challenges, create sustainable outcomes and build trust in business and society. As part of our Experience Consulting team, you will accompany our clients on the way to a new or improved digital product with designs, concepts and qualitative user research. We combine design thinking methods with collaborative workshop formats to involve as many stakeholders as possible from brainstorming to go-live. Help us to leverage the growth potential of our clients in the digital world!ContactIf you have any questions about this position or your application, please reach out to Felix Baumecker at +49 69 9585-2222.

In doing so, you will identify growth opportunities, conduct market and sector analyses, and contribute to market sizing, competitive benchmarking, portfolio reviews, and commercial due diligences. Advisory - You will support senior team members in translating complex data into strategic recommendations that help shape PwC’s market position, profitability, and return on investment. You will also build your internal and external network across PwC, its advisors, and other professional services firms.  Transformation - You will contribute to deal pipelines and value creation plans in integration and carve-out projects, supporting a smooth transition from strategy to execution. This includes close collaboration with business units, internal functions such as Finance, and internal and external advisors across the deal lifecycle.Your profile- You have completed or are about to complete your studies in Business Administration, Finance, Mathematics, Engineering or Natural Sciences with a business-related focus.- You have gained more than three years of professional experience in Strategy Consulting, Private Equity, Corporate Development or In-house M&A and have worked across different stages of the deal lifecycle.- Experience in portfolio reviews, market assessments, commercial due diligence, transformation initiatives and value creation projects enables you to develop robust analyses and support strategic decision-making in a dynamic environment.- You are fluent in English and German both spoken and written. The team language is English.- You enjoy working in diverse international teams, navigate complex stakeholder environments with confidence and bring the flexibility to travel occasionally across the EMEA region when projects require it.Your benefitsFlexibility – In coordination with your team, you can expect a mix of working in the office and home office. There are no core working hours – within the scope of operational requirements and legal regulations, you can organize your working hours flexibly. In addition, you have the opportunity to work temporarily in over 40 countries.Career Development – We are passionate about your personal and professional development, therefore we offer your regular training with our internal Academy, international experiences by doing a secondment and continuous mentoring on the job. Also, we support you on finding suitable external trainings and further education programmes. Lifestyle – You can accumulate overtime on your annual working time account (JAZ) and compensate for it with time off after busy periods. Any remaining overtime is paid out once a year. You also have 30 days of vacation per calendar year.Health and Wellbeing – Your health is important to us: in addition to our own company health insurance scheme, we also offer preventive medical check-ups and  divers sport offerings. Take part in our free company sports programme or benefit from reduced rates at various gyms or an Urban Sports Club membership.And there is even more – It is our purpose to create a positive working environment: An environment where flexible and creative working is possible, where work is recognized and performance is rewarded and of which we are all very proud. You can find more detailed information on all of our benefits on our career website. At PwC Germany, it is our purpose to solve our clients' key challenges, create sustainable outcomes and build trust in business and society.  In our Business Services we cover internal topics such as HR, Marketing, Finance, Middle Office, IT or our internal legal advice. Drive the development of PwC Germany in our various teams and use your expertise to strengthen our position as a potential employer. We offer you an exciting working environment where you can contribute your ideas and skills. ContactIf you have any questions about this position or your application, please reach out to Patricia Weiss at +49 69 9585-2222.

jobs.description: Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.comThe PositionJoin our Medicinal Chemistry Department and help us explore the full potential of NMR in drug discovery.As an NMR Specialist, you will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, providing structural insights into protein-ligand complexes and supporting projects with NMR-based screening data. Using our state-of-the-art facilities, you will have the opportunity to develop and apply innovative NMR approaches and contribute directly to advancing our drug discovery projects.We are looking for someone who combines scientific curiosity with agility, accountability and an entrepreneurial mindset, and who enjoys working collaboratively to turn new ideas into meaningful scientific impact.Discover our Biberach site: xplorebiberach.comThis position is limited for 2 years.Postdoc: This Position is limited for 2 years.To make it easier to find our job advertisements, we use the usual designation "postdoc". Of course, this advertisement is not only addressed to applicants directly after completing their doctorate, but to all qualified candidates.Tasks & responsibilities- One of your key tasks will be to explore and implement NMR experiments and technologies to develop an infrastructure capable of fast and robust NMR protein and protein ligand co-structure determination by combining traditional strategies with modern AI tools- Moreover, you will apply state-of-the-art NMR experiments to enable integral membrane proteins to characterize binding events, conformational changes and dynamics- In addition, you will increase speed of resonance assignment by automation of processes and software packages such as NMRtist- Furthermore, you will conduct protein- and ligand-detected Fragment Based screening by NMR, optimize automated analysis workflows and provide validated hits to project teams- You will also provide hands-on support in maintaining NMR and lab equipment infrastructure- You will have the opportunity to work together with protein scientists to express and purify isotopically labeled proteinsRequirements- You have a Ph.D. degree in Biochemistry, Structural Biology, or Biophysics or a related area with a strong background in Protein NMR spectroscopy- You have a thorough understanding of NMR structure determination and are keen to study and compare a variety of NMR methods and build an optimized infrastructure- You have proven your skills in publications and presentations- You are experienced in cloning and expressing labeled protein targets including selective labeling- You can work independently, plan, organize, troubleshoot, present work and show innovative thinking in multidisciplinary teams- You are well organized, and have strong interpersonal and communication skills- English (fluent verbal and written) and German are our working languagesAs part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We are seeking a highly motivated PhD candidate to join our Systems Biology Department at the Institute of Biomedical Genetics (IBMG), University of Stuttgart (https://www.ibmg.uni-stuttgart.de/systems_biology/). jobs.occupation: Teleoperator (m/w/d) – Robotersteuerung per VR [BA/JC] (Maschinen- und Anlagenführer/in (ohne Angabe des Schwerpunkts))
jobs.description: Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:Robotics Experte; Fernsteuerer/in (Robotik); Roboterbediener/in; KI-Trainer/inStellenbeschreibung:DeutschBerufsbezeichnung: Teleoperator / Teleoperatorin (m/w/d) – Robotersteuerung per VR (Praktikum mit Option auf Festanstellung)Über unsWir entwickeln die Technologie, mit der Roboter in der echten Welt sehen, verstehen und handeln können – in Lagern und Fabriken, nicht im Labor. Unsere Mission: die Lücken schließen, an denen klassische Automatisierung scheitert.Deine AufgabeDu steuerst Roboter über ein VR-Headset und hilfst so dabei, ihnen beizubringen, wie man Aufgaben in der echten Welt erledigt. Konkret:- Roboter per VR-Headset fernsteuern und dabei hochwertige Bewegungsdaten erzeugen- Bild- und Sensordaten sichten und mit hoher Sorgfalt kennzeichnen (Labeling)- Einfache, vorgegebene Abläufe am PC ausführen (wir zeigen dir genau, wie)- Auffälligkeiten dokumentieren: was ist passiert, was hättest du erwartet, wann genau- Enger Austausch mit einem kleinen, eingespielten TeamWas du mitbringen solltest- Keine Vorerfahrung nötig – wir bringen dir alles bei, was du für den Job brauchst- Gute Deutsch- oder gute Englischkenntnisse (mündlich und schriftlich)- Ruhige Hand, gutes Auge fürs Detail und Geduld bei sich wiederholenden Aufgaben- Grundlegende PC-Kenntnisse (E-Mails schreiben, Dateien verwalten reicht völlig)- Lust, dich in eine neue, ungewöhnliche Tätigkeit einzuarbeiten- Räumliches Vorstellungsvermögen und gutes Reaktionsvermögen sind hilfreich – wer gern zockt, bringt hier oft schon ein gutes Gespür für Steuerung und Timing mit- Zuverlässigkeit und pünktliches ErscheinenWo und wieStuttgart-Vaihingen, vor Ort (kein Homeoffice möglich, da mit der Technik vor Ort gearbeitet wird).Art der Stelle & VerdienstStart als Praktikum, max. 6 Monate, Vollzeit (40 Std./Woche), 2.500 € brutto/Monat. Nach erfolgreichem Praktikum ist ein Einstieg in eine Festanstellung möglich, mit Verdienstmöglichkeiten von bis zu 65.000 € brutto/Jahr, abhängig von Erfahrung und Übernahme von Verantwortung.BewerbungBitte sende uns deinen Lebenslauf. Ein klassisches Anschreiben ist nicht nötig – schreib uns stattdessen kurz, warum du Lust auf die Stelle hast.Unser Ablauf1. Bewerbung (Lebenslauf + kurze Nachricht)2. Schnuppertag vor Ort: Du lernst das Team kennen und bearbeitest gemeinsam eine reale Aufgabe aus dem Arbeitsalltag, um ein echtes Gefühl für die Stelle zu bekommenEnglishJob title: Teleoperator (m/f/d) – Robot Control via VR (Internship with option to convert to full-time)Who We AreWe build the intelligence that lets robots sense, reason, and act in the real world – moving beyond the lab and into everyday industrial settings like warehouses and factories. Our technology closes the automation gaps that traditional systems can't solve.Your RoleYou'll control robots through a VR headset, helping teach them how to carry out real-world tasks. Specifically:- Operate robots via a VR headset to generate high-quality movement data- Review and label visual and sensor data with care and precision- Carry out simple, well-defined tasks on the computer (we'll show you exactly how)- Document anything unusual: what happened, what you expected, and when- Work closely with a small, hands-on teamWhat You Should Bring- No prior experience required – we'll teach you everything you need for the job- Good German or good English skills (spoken and written)- A steady hand, good attention to detail, and patience with repetitive tasks- Basic computer skills (writing emails, managing files is plenty)- Willingness to learn a new and unusual kind of work- Good spatial awareness and reaction time are a plus – if you enjoy video games, you likely already have a feel for control and timing- Reliability and punctualityLocation & SetupStuttgart-Vaihingen, on-site (remote work isn't possible, as the role requires working with the hardware in person).Type of Role & PayStarts as an internship, max. 6 months, full-time (40 h/week), €2,500 gross/month. jobs.occupation: Experienced Red Teamer / Pentester - Cybersecurity Audit (m/f/d) - DISW (Informatiker/in)
jobs.description: Start your cyber career with us!As part of the global Cybersecurity Assurance function, we help Siemens to achieve their goals by providing objective, factual and independent assurance to the Siemens Managing Board and Audit Committee. As a business partner to Siemens executive management, we leverage our expertise in a wide range of topics to create an impact that drives change. We offer a vibrant and inclusive environment which ensures a variety of perspectives and enables big picture thinking.To deliver on our vision of being pioneers in assurance and a talent incubator for Siemens, we offer a unique Grow and Development Model. We believe in the concept of lifelong learning and therefore encourage our people towards a mindset where continuous upskilling and reskilling becomes a natural part of our career. We invest in our expertise and therefore provide continuous career coaching, trainings and mentoring, all whilst working with top Siemens business leaders on multiple high-profile projects around the world.Our Cybersecurity team provides core assurance over the cybersecurity health of the company which includes IT infrastructures, product security, software development and cloud environments. We are on the lookout for people with a great skillset, an international mindset and new ideas who understand Siemens businesses and how Cybersecurity helps enable and increase market value. Are you one of them?To discover more about the global Siemens assurance function click here (https://assets.new.siemens.com/siemens/assets/api/uuid:832d2c5d-e30c-4163-a1be-9fa3d67f645b/controlling-and-finance-assurance-info-for-applicants.pdf) .What part will you play?- As valuable member of the assurance team you will be responsible for conducting and driving Cybersecurity assessments across the entire Siemens landscape, including products, services, IT-systems, and software development centers. During this process you will plan and perform ethical hacking activities, design attack scenarios for state-of-the-art technologies and highlight important observations to translate technical findings into management information so that they can take effective actions. - Apply advanced hacking principles and red team methodologies, tools and techniques to mimic real-world threat behaviors faced by the Siemens’s digital environment, e.g. cloud applications, on-premise infrastructure, digital products and services.- You work closely with cybersecurity experts from multiple industries to improve their solutions by tackling the root cause of the issues and find innovative solutions to modern challenges.- You independently conduct research on latest developments in cybersecurity technologies and threats and understand how this is impacting and changing the Siemens’ environment.You'll win us over by having the following qualifications:- Strong academic history (Bachelor degree) in IT, Computer Science or other related fields; certifications such as GIAC GPEN, OSCP, OSWE, CRTO, CREST, etc. are a plus. - Good scripting and programming skills and experience with languages such as Bash, Python, Powershell, and C++ / C#.- At least 5+ years of professional full-time working experience within Siemens or a related industry in penetration testing / red teaming with a proven record of continuous career development.- Demonstrated affinity to learn about the latest trends in cybersecurity and keep up to date in a continuously challenging environment.- You have solid experience with one or more of the following aspects of penetration testing / red teaming: application and software security, EDR and antivirus evasion, C2 setup, automation and scaling of security testing, Active Directory attacks, etc.- Demonstrated experience in capture the flag (CTFs) events, bug hunting or vulnerability research (CVEs) is a plus.- Experience with leveraging and integrating AI into day-to-day work is considered an advantage.- Fluent in English. German or other languages are a plus.- You demonstrate an international mindset and are open to international travel, and working in a diverse teamWhile commitment to our job improves performance, growth happens when we stretch beyond our comfort zone. FIN A offers ample opportunities to seek the challenge:Caring for the world around us is a crucial part of our working culture at FIN A for over a decade.Everyone at FIN A has the possibility to actively engage in our global Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) community and make an impact with our socially and environmentally motivated CSR projects.What we offer- 2 to 3 days of mobile working per week as a future global standard- An environment where everyone can bring their whole self to work and feel a sense of belonging- 30 leave days and a variety of flexible working models that allow time off for yourself and your family (for Germany)- Share matching programs to become a shareholder of Siemens AG- Pension plan to ensure financial security - 50+ learning hours per year for both personal and professional growthWhy us?Working at Siemens Digital Industries Software means flexibility - Choosing between working at home and the office at other times is the norm here. We offer great benefits and rewards, as you'd expect from a world leader in industrial software.We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Through our PPD® clinical research services, we support clinical trials in more than 100 countries, delivering laboratory, digital and decentralized solutions that help bring life-changing therapies to patients faster.Our global Clinical Operations teams provide end-to-end clinical trial support — from study start-up through close-out — across commercial and government-sponsored studies.Why Join Thermo Fisher Scientific / PPD?- Work on high-quality, global clinical trials across diverse therapeutic areas- Be part of a stable, well-established organization with long-term career opportunities- Strong collaboration with experienced CTMs and project teams- Clear development pathways (e.g. Lead CRA, CTM)- Flexible working models that support work-life balance- Permanent employment- Full-time (40 hours/week) or Part-time (32 hours/week) options availableAbout the RoleWe are seeking a highly experienced Principal Clinical Research Associate (CRA) to lead and coordinate all aspects of clinical monitoring and site management for complex clinical trials. Acting as a subject-matter expert and site process specialist, you will ensure trials are conducted in accordance with the approved protocol, ICH-GCP, applicable regulatory requirements, and internal SOPs—ensuring subject safety, data integrity, and continuous audit readiness.In this principal-level role, you will manage complex and high-risk studies across multiple sponsor and monitoring models (e.g. FSO, FSP, government-sponsored research). You will serve as a key escalation point for sites and project teams, take a leadership role on assigned studies, and actively contribute to the mentoring and development of junior and senior CRAs alike.What You’ll DoPrincipal-Level Clinical Monitoring & Oversight- Lead monitoring activities for complex, high-risk, or strategically important clinical trials using a risk-based monitoring approach- Independently conduct on-site and remote monitoring visits in line with approved monitoring plans- Perform and oversee SDR, SDV, and CRF review, ensuring the highest standards of data accuracy and integrity- Evaluate investigational product accountability through physical inventory and records review- Ensure essential documents are complete, inspection-ready, and compliant with root cause analysis (RCA), critical thinking, and problem-solving methodologies to identify systemic site issues- Strategic Project & Stakeholder Collaboration- Serve as a trusted partner to investigative sites, sponsors, and internal project teams- Identify trends across sites and studies and provide strategic recommendations to the Clinical Team Manager (CTM)- Ensure accurate and timely updates of study systems (e.g. CTMS) and perform QC reviews where required- Participate in investigator meetings and support investigator identification and feasibility activities- Support investigator payment processes and trial financial oversight as applicableLeadership, Mentorship & Process Improvement- Actively mentor, coach, and support the development of junior and senior CRAs- Contribute to project-specific and functional training initiatives- Identify opportunities for process optimization and drive implementation of improvements- Provide expert input into monitoring strategies and clinical operations best practicesAdministrative & Operational Responsibilities- Maintain timely and accurate completion of timesheets, expense reports, and required documentation- Maintain frequent communication with sites between visits to ensure ongoing compliance and issue resolution- - Drive corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs) to resolution and proactively mitigate risk- Author high-quality monitoring reports and follow-up correspondence in a timely manner- Act as a key escalation point for significant site issues, protocol deviations, and compliance risks- Support and lead activities related to audits, inspections, and regulatory inquiriesEducation & Experience- Bachelor’s degree in a life sciences related field or equivalent qualification- Minimum 5+ years of experience as a Clinical Research Associate / Monitor- Valid driver’s license- Full right to work in Germany- Fluency in German and English (C1 level) – interviews will be conducted in GermanKnowledge, Skills & Abilities- Strong clinical monitoring skills with hands-on RBM experience- Excellent understanding and application of ICH-GCP and applicable regulations- Solid therapeutic area knowledge and medical terminology- Well-developed critical thinking, problem-solving, and root cause analysis skills- Strong written and verbal communication skills with medical professionals- High attention to detail and strong organizational skills- Ability to work independently while contributing effectively to cross-functional teams- Flexibility and adaptability in a dynamic project environment- Proficiency in Microsoft Office and ability to learn clinical systems (e.g., CTMS)Locations: Home-based or hybrid anywhere in GermanyFTE: Full-time (40 hrs/week) or Part-time 80% (32 hrs/week)Contract: PermanentTravel: Approximately 50–75% (study-dependent)Severely disabled applicants with the same aptitude will be given preferential treatment.
