Our missionEvery 3 seconds, somewhere in the world, a person develops dementia. Today, more than 55 million people worldwide are living with dementia, and due to the aging population, this number is expected to rise to 78 million by 2030 and 139 million by 2050. The World Health Organization therefore classifies dementia as a public health priority. Even though dementia is still incurable, there have been significant developments in this field recently: disease-modifying drugs for the early stages of Alzheimer's disease have now been approved for the first time. We have made it our mission to enable early medical assessment and continuous monitoring of memory problems associated with Alzheimer's disease. That is why we have developed digital cognitive tests that are embedded in smartphone apps and can be used in research or healthcare.Your responsibilitiesneotiv develops digital cognitive assessments to detect and monitor cognitive impairment along the Alzheimer’s disease continuum. Our assessments are used as outcome measures in pharma-sponsored clinical trials and academic studies. To strengthen our Science & Innovation Team, we are looking for a Project Manager Study Coordination (35 hours/week, based in Magdeburg, Berlin, or remotely) who will take responsibility for delivering these studies from setup to close-out, serving as the main point of contact for sponsors, CROs, and study sites. The position is fixed-term until 31 January 2028 as parental leave cover, with the prospect of an extension or a permanent position.• Plan, set up, run and close studies and clinical trials in which neotiv assessments are used, including milestone and timeline tracking against contractual scopes of work.• Act as the main point of contact for sponsors, CROs, academic partners and study sites, and build and maintain strong working relationships with them.• Coordinate the study setup and configuration of the neotivPortal and neotivTrials app, including user acceptance testing (UAT) with the sponsor.• Plan and deliver site and study-team trainings and prepare onboarding materials, also in multiple languages.• Prepare study documentation and protocols, and support ethics/IRB and funding applications.• Manage change requests and scope questions in close alignment with our product, development and support teams.• Help acquire new project partners and keep track of scientific developments relevant to neotiv.Your profile• MSc in Psychology, Neuroscience, Neurology, Medicine or a related field. A PhD is an advantage.• 3–5 years of professional experience managing clinical and/or academic research studies. Experience on the vendor or technology-provider side of clinical trials (e.g. digital biomarker, CRO or similar), working with pharma sponsors, is strongly preferred.• Good knowledge of the clinical trial setting, ideally including ethics/IRB submissions, site training and sponsor/CRO collaboration.• Experience leading project teams and coordinating multiple stakeholders and workstreams in parallel.• Interest in and knowledge of cognitive neuroscience and neurodegeneration. Knowledge of digital health and precision medicine is a plus.• Fluent German and English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.• Confident use of Microsoft 365 and common project management tools (Jira/Confluence).• A reliable, structured way of working with a strong eye for detail, and the ability to stay calm and flexible when timelines or requirements change.• Willingness to travel occasionally.What we have to offer• Flexible working from our offices in Magdeburg and Berlin, or from home.• Flexible working hours and 30 days of annual leave.• Monthly benefits worth €65 net (mobility allowance, non-cash benefit and/or Urban Sports Club membership).• A childcare allowance of up to €135 net per month, if needed.• An occupational pension scheme, with the employer contribution rising to up to 80% with length of service.• A training budget for your professional and personal development.• Monthly Creative Days for new ideas, collaboration and room to develop creatively.• A great team that enjoys its work and is committed to high standards of quality and professionalism.Your point of contactSend us your CV and cover letter, addressed to our People & Culture Team. If you have questions, we are happy to answer them by email at jobs@neotiv.com or by phone.About usneotiv is a team of currently about 30 people: Scientists, developers and technically enthusiastic people who share a common vision of a better prevention of dementia. We develop digital solutions for the early detection and monitoring of memory problems.neotiv is a spin-off from Otto-von-Guericke-University Magdeburg in close cooperation with the German Centre for Neurodegenerative Diseases (DZNE). Our team is passionate about shaping the future of medical care with digital tools and advancing dementia research. We work in Magdeburg, Berlin and across Germany and Europe. We are funded by renowned investors and science transfer funds that enable us to realize our mission of improving people's lives.

Good to know...Hybrid with a flexible office policy · Based in Germany, with regular travel to Berlin · Full-time · Reports to the Head of GrowthPets Deli has grown into a leading premium pet food D2C brand in Germany, with recipes developed by veterinarians, a loyal customer base, and a marketing engine built around measurable results.You own how we measure the brand and what we invest in it. You treat brand building like any other investment: with a clear question, a budget, and a way to measure the effect. You work closely with our performance, creative, influencer, and country teams, and you manage the agencies and research partners behind the work.You start from a strong brand. You find out what drives its perception, set priorities among those drivers, and turn them into sharp, differentiating communication that extends reach and builds not only brand awareness but also trust and preference.You shape the positioning and the messaging, develop and run our brand building beyond the performance channels, and bring customer insight into the decisions of the marketing team.This is not a role about approving content. It is about giving the whole team something worth saying, and showing what it returns. jobs.employer_name: Weierstraß-Institut für Angewandte Analysis und Stochastik (WIAS)
jobs.description: The Weierstrass Institute for Applied Analysis and Stochastics (WIAS) is an institute of the Forschungsverbund Berlin e.V. (FVB). The FVB comprises seven non-university research institutes in Berlin which are funded by the federal and state governments. The research institutes belong to the Leibniz Association.WIAS invites applications for aResearch Assistant Position (f/m/d)(Ref. 26/22)in the Research Group “Nonsmooth Variational Problems and Operator Equations ”(Head: Prof. Dr. Michael Hintermüller),starting on January 1, 2027 .Field of work:The successful candidate will work in the MATH+ project "DOC-TWIN: Duality-Based Error Control for Optimal Control Problems in Digital-Twin-Based Structural Health Monitoring". The project aims at developing a convex-duality-based framework for reliable error control in PDE-constrained optimal control problems motivated by digital-twin-based structural health monitoring.The Tasks include:- Developing and analyzing duality-based a posteriori error identities for PDE-constrained optimal control problems;- Deriving corresponding discrete a priori error identities and using them for convergence-rate analysis and certified nonlinear solver control;- Designing, implementing, and numerically validating finite element methods, including adaptive mesh-refinement strategies and suitable post-processing techniques;- Preparing scientific publications and presenting the results at workshops and conferences.**We are looking for: **Applicants with:- A very good university degree in mathematics, computational science, engineering, or a closely related field;- A strong interest in numerical analysis, optimization, partial differential equations, or scientific computing;- A willingness to work on both the mathematical analysis and the implementation of numerical methods for PDE-constrained optimization problems;- Good communication skills and the ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in an interdisciplinary research environment;- Good written and spoken English skills.Desirable Qualifications:Experience in one or more of the following areas is an advantage but not a requirement:- Finite element methods, adaptive methods, or a posteriori error estimation;- Convex analysis, nonsmooth optimization, or optimal control;- PDE-constrained optimization or inverse problems;- Numerical methods for elasticity, structural mechanics, or related models;- Implementation of numerical methods in Python, MATLAB, Julia, C/C++, or finite element software.What we offer:- The opportunity to work at WIAS Berlin, a leading research institution with strengths in partial differential equations, mathematical modeling, nonlinear optimization, and applied mathematics in general;- The option of mobile working;- A certified family-friendly work environment (Audit berufundfamilie);- The opportunity to live and work in Berlin, one of the world's most culturally rich and diverse international cities. Berlin offers a wide range of opportunities to enjoy life outside work while remaining relatively affordable compared with other major cities. Neither the position nor living in Berlin requires knowledge of German, although WIAS offers free German courses. We particularly welcome international applicants. Berlin also offers a rich scientific landscape, with numerous research opportunities and career prospects in both academia and industry;- Close mentorship from the supervisor and other peers through a dedicated mentorship program.Please direct scientific queries to Prof Dr. Michael Hintermüller (michael.hintermueller@wias-berlin.de).The appointment is limited to two years. The position is full-time (39 hours per week), with a salary based on pay grade E 13 of the German TVöD Bund pay scale.WIAS is committed to fostering diversity and equal opportunities and particularly encourages women to apply. Applicants with disabilities will be given preferential consideration in cases of equal qualification. If you have any questions or want to provide us with information related to diversity, inclusion or disabilities, please feel free to consult our website orcontact our Diversity Officer, Sara Krummenacher (sara.krummenacher@wias-berlin.de).How to apply:Please upload your complete application documents (motivation letter, detailed CV, certificates, copy of the master thesis, etc.) via our applicant portal using the button “Apply online”.The application period opens immediately and remains open until the position is filled.We are looking forward to your application!

Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:CPO; Chief-Product-Officer; Product OwnerStellenbeschreibung:About HeyGermanyGermany urgently needs international talent. Yet complex and lengthy recognition processes prevent many qualified professionals from working in the jobs they trained for. At the same time, employers struggle to fill critical positions.HeyGermany wants to change that. We are building the digital infrastructure to make professional recognition and work integration faster and easier. We are starting with nursing and plan to expand into other regulated professions. Our mission is to remove bureaucratic barriers and help international talent access jobs that match their qualifications.The RoleWe are looking for a hands-on, product-driven Founding CTPO with the ambition to build HeyGermany as a co-founder. You will take full ownership of both product and technology, from understanding customer problems and defining our product vision to building, launching and scaling the solutions.You will work closely with the Founder & CEO to shape company strategy, identify growth opportunities and turn our vision into a product that users love and businesses are willing to pay for.We already have a live MVP (www.hey-germany.com (http://www.hey-germany.com) ), an initial recognition engine and talent pool, 400+ talent pool conversions, our first enterprise pilot and secured public funding.Your challenge is to turn this foundation into a scalable, user-centric platform that can take HeyGermany from one profession to many, while building the product and technology capabilities to support long-term growth.What You’ll Do- Own our product vision, strategy and roadmap, translating customer needs, business goals and market insights into clear priorities and measurable outcomes.- Lead product discovery and development end-to-end, from user research, problem validation and prototyping to technical implementation, launch and iteration.- Own our technology strategy and architecture, building scalable systems for qualification recognition, document processing, workflow automation and talent matching.- Turn complex regulatory and bureaucratic processes into simple, intuitive digital experiences, with a strong focus on usability, customer value and conversion.- Stay hands-on in building the product, making key technical decisions across frontend, backend, APIs, data and cloud infrastructure while maintaining a high standard of product quality.- Identify and develop AI-powered product opportunities where they create real value, particularly in document analysis, structured data extraction, intelligent matching and workflow automation.- Work directly with international professionals, employers and domain experts to understand their needs, validate assumptions and continuously improve the product.- Define and track key product metrics, using data, user feedback and experimentation to drive product decisions, engagement, conversion and business outcomes.- Build and lead our future product and engineering team, establishing a strong culture of ownership, customer focus, speed and continuous learning.What We’re Looking For- We care less about your current title than about what you have built, your product judgment and the level of ownership you are ready to take.- 7+ years of experience in software engineering, product development or technical product leadership, with strong hands-on technical capabilities.- A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.- A proven track record of building and shipping digital products end-to-end, ideally in a founder, founding engineer, product-minded CTO, technical product lead or similar role.- Strong product thinking, with the ability to identify real customer problems, validate solutions, prioritize effectively and balance user needs with business impact and technical feasibility.- Strong experience with a modern web stack, ideally TypeScript, React/Next.js, backend development, APIs, databases and cloud infrastructure.- Practical experience building with LLMs and modern AI systems, including RAG, agents and evaluations, and using AI effectively in product development and day-to-day work.- Experience with product discovery, user research, UX principles, product analytics and iterative development. You know how to move from an initial hypothesis to a product that delivers measurable value.- The ability to make pragmatic decisions across product and technology, balancing speed, user experience, quality and scalability in an early-stage environment.- A strong understanding of how product decisions connect to business outcomes, including acquisition, activation, retention and monetization.- A founder mindset and strong connection to our mission**.** You want real ownership, are comfortable with the ambiguity of a pre-seed company and care about building a successful business, not just great technology.- Strong English communication skills are required. German is a plus.- Experience with document intelligence/OCR, B2B SaaS, marketplaces, HR Tech, Global Mobility or regulated/GDPR-sensitive products is valuable, but not required.What We Offer- €50,000–€65,000 annual base salary, with salary growth as the company scales, plus meaningful equity reflecting the founder-level ownership of the role.- The opportunity to become a true co-founder, with long-term ownership of product and technology and meaningful participation in the company’s upside.- Founder-level influence over product vision, technology and company strategy, with the freedom to shape what we build, how we build it and how we grow.- The opportunity to build our product, technology architecture and future product and engineering organisation from the ground up.- A live product, early traction, our first enterprise pilot and secured public funding. We are currently in conversations with investors for our next stage of growth.- The opportunity to work on a problem with tangible social and economic impact: helping international professionals access jobs that match their qualifications while helping employers access talent they urgently need.We believe professional opportunities should be determined by people’s skills, not by their ability to navigate bureaucracy.If you want to build both the product and the technology behind a company from the ground up, take real ownership and help shape HeyGermany as a co-founder, we would love to hear from you.Send us one product you've built that you're proud of, tell us what role you played in bringing it to life, and why this mission matters to you.katharina@hey-germany.com (https://mailto:katharina@hey-germany.com)Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach Vereinbarung

With Tech and Operations: CHF pricing, payment methods, legal texts, customs handling and delivery promises that match the German experience.• Market strategy. A growth plan for Switzerland: what we take from Germany, what we adapt to Swiss customers, pricing, competition and media.• Pricing and assortment. jobs.description: - The Institute of Active Polymers at Helmholtz-Zentrum Hereon is seeking a Postdoctoral Researcher in Mechanobiology & Digital Twins for its activities in the field of stem cell modification and biomaterials at its Teltow site. The position is initially limited until 30 November 2028.Equal opportunity is an integral part of our personnel policy. The full-time position (39 hours per week) can, in principle, also be filled on a part-time basis.Your tasks:Scientific and methodological tasks:- design and perform mechanobiology experiments with primary T cells, B cells and/or other immune cells at engineered biomaterial interfaces- develop, optimize and apply advanced fluorescence and super-resolution microscopy to resolve receptor organization, close-contact formation, cytoskeletal architecture and signalling in living and fixed cells- establish and use biomaterial model systems, including nanostructured surfaces, hydrogels/​​viscoelastic materials and functionalized interfaces with controlled mechanics, topography and ligand presentation- build quantitative image-analysis workflows for large 2D/3D/4D microscopy data sets and extract spatial, dynamic and biophysical features at the single-cell and subcellular level- integrate imaging, mechanical and functional measurements into digital-twin models of immune-cell activation and cell-material interactions- develop, fit and validate mechanistic and data-driven models (e.g. ODE, agent-based, biophysical, statistical or machine-learning approaches as appropriate), including parameter inference and sensitivity analysis- use an iterative model-experiment cycle to generate testable predictions and experimentally validate and refine the digital twins- quantify immune-cell activation, signalling, morphology and function using complementary cellbiological and biophysical assays, including flow cytometry and live-cell measurements- cooperate closely with microscopy, materials-science, computational and immunology partners and contribute to shared experimental and data standards- prepare scientific publications, conference contributions, invention disclosures where relevant, and contribute to follow-up funding and grant applications- supervise MSc students and interns and contribute to the scientific mentoring of PhD studentsRelated tasks:- literature and data analysis in the relevant fields; documentation and reproducible/​FAIR management of imaging, analysis and modelling workflows- procurement of materials and consumables; participation in group, institute and project meetings, partner meetings, trainings and scientific networking activities- preparation and maintenance of experimental protocols, analysis code, model documentation, progress reports and training materialsYour profile:Education:- Doctoral degree (PhD/Dr.) in biophysics, physics, bioengineering/​biomedical engineering, materials science/​biomaterials, cell biology, immunology or a comparable fieldExpertise and experience:- strong hands-on expertise in at least one of the following areas: advanced fluorescence/​superresolution microscopy, quantitative bioimaging, mechanobiology or biomaterials; demonstrated ability and motivation to expand into the adjacent areas- experience with mammalian cell culture; experience with primary immune cells and immune-cell assays is highly desirable- experience with SMLM, SIM, STED, light-sheet or comparable advanced microscopy methods is desirable- knowledge of cell-material interfaces, hydrogels, nanostructured surfaces and/or mechano­transduction is advantageous- strong quantitative image-analysis skills and scientific programming experience (e.g. Python, MATLAB or R; Fiji/​lmageJ or comparable tools)- experience with mathematical modelling, machine learning or digital-twin approaches is an advantage; a strong interest in integrating experiments with predictive models is expected- demonstrated capacity for independent scientific work, publication of research results, interdisciplinary teamwork and clear scientific communication in EnglishOur offer:- an exciting and varied job in a research center with around 1,000 employees from more than 60 nations- an International Welcome Office with guest accommodation- 6 weeks holiday per year; company holidays between Christmas and New Year's Day- social benefits under the collective agreement for the German public sector and remuneration up to pay grade 13 (EntgO Bund)- very good work-life balance; options for mobile and flexible working- a well-connected research campus, good networking opportunities, a subsidized Deutschlandticket (job ticket) subject to certain conditions- individual opportunities jobs.occupation: PhD Positions in Agentic AI for Medical Image Analysis (Informatiker/in)
jobs.description: The German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ) is one of Europe’s largest cancer research centers. “Research for a life without cancer" is the mission of our world-class scientists and all our team members.We investigate how cancer develops, identify cancer risk factors and search for new cancer prevention strategies. We develop new methods with which tumors can be diagnosed more precisely and cancer patients can be treated more successfully. Every contribution counts – whether in research, administration or infrastructure. This is what makes our daily work so meaningful and exciting.The Division of Medical Image Computing (MIC) at the German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ) in Heidelberg, starting in January 2027, is offering PhD Positions in Agentic AI for Medical Image Analysis.The Division of Medical Image Computing (MIC) is recruiting PhD candidates to develop AI agents that interpret medical images, use analysis tools, evaluate intermediate results, and adapt their approach based on evidence and feedback.Candidates will join a collaborative research environment with clinical partners, extensive computing infrastructure, and connections to initiatives such as Helmholtz Imaging.Your TasksWe investigate how AI agents can combine medical images with clinical information, plan and execute analytical steps, learn from feedback, assess intermediate results, and respond appropriately to uncertainty or failure. Approaches may include reinforcement learning, multimodal learning, vision-language models, planning, tool-augmented language models, probabilistic modelling, and classical medical image analysis.Candidates may work primarily in one of several application areas:1. multimodal agents for prostate cancer diagnosis and treatment support;2. auditable analysis of longitudinal imaging for tumour-response assessment;3. federated multimodal agents connecting oral imaging with systemic health information; or4. or reinforcement learning for agents that navigate and integrate complex data across medical and other scientific domains.The individual PhD topic will be developed jointly based on the candidate’s interests, expertise, and the methodological questions arising across these applications.You will:- develop agents that combine medical images with clinical text and other information;- investigate reinforcement learning for planning, tool use, feedback integration, and iterative improvement;- apply agentic methods to segmentation, annotation, quantitative analysis, or scientific data exploration;- establish rigorous evaluation methods covering accuracy, robustness, generalisation, uncertainty calibration, failure detection, and appropriate abstention; and- collaborate with methodological and clinical researchers, publish your results, and contribute reusable software or benchmarks.Your ProfileYou should have:- A master’s degree in computer science, data science, mathematics, physics, engineering, or a related discipline- A strong foundation in machine learning and strong Python programming skills- Practical experience with a deep-learning framework such as PyTorch- Experience in at least one relevant area, such as reinforcement learning, computer vision, language models, multimodal learning, or medical-image analysis- An analytical and collaborative working style and good communication skills in EnglishPrevious experience with medical data is helpful but not required. We also welcome candidates with strong machine-learning fundamentals who want to develop expertise in agentic AI.What you can excpect:- Scientific freedom to develop your own methodological research question- Close supervision and exchange within a cohort of PhD researchers- Access to extensive GPU infrastructure, medical-imaging resources, and established research software- Collaboration with international machine-learning and clinical partners- Support for conference participation, open-source contributions, and professional development- Fully funded PhD submissionPlease submit:- your CV- academic transcripts- a brief research statement of no more than one page describing a question in agentic AI that interests you- your preferred application area, or a ranking of the available areas- your master’s thesis or another representative piece of scientific work- links to relevant publications, software, or code repositories, if available- Instead of a generic motivation letter, please use your research statement to explain which scientific question you would like to investigate, why it matters, and how you might approach itWe Offer- Excellent framework conditions: state-of-the-art equipment and opportunities for international networking at the highest level- Access to international research networks- Doctoral salary with the usual social benefits- 30 days of vacation per year- Flexible working hours- Possibility of part-time work- Family-friendly working environment- Sustainable travel to work: subsidized Germany job ticket- Unleash your full potential: targeted training and mentoring through the DKFZ International PhD Program and DKFZ Career Service- Our Corporate Health Management Program offers a holistic approach to your well-beingAre you interested?Then become part of the DKFZ and join us in contributing to a life without cancer!Contact:Constantin Ulrich HarsyPhone: +49 (0) 6221/42-3552Duration: The positions are initially limited to 3 years.Application Deadline: December 2, 2026Applications by e-mail cannot be accepted.Please also note that we cannot return applications submitted by post.We are convinced that an innovative research and working environment thrives on the diversity of its employees. Therefore, we welcome applications from talented people, regardless of gender, cultural background, nationality, ethnicity, sexual identity, physical ability, religion and age. People with severe disabilities are given preference if they have the same aptitude.Notice: We are subject to the regulations of the Infection Protection Act (IfSG). Therefore, all our employees must provide proof of immunity against measles.

The HelloFresh Group includes eight brands serving customers across multiple meal occasions, including HelloFresh, Green Chef, EveryPlate, and Chefs Plate, as well as ready-to-eat meals from Factor and YouFoodz, meat and seafood subscriptions through Good Chop, and pet nutrition with The Pets Table. Through technology, data, and culinary innovation, we deliver personalized food experiences to millions of households worldwide. The roleThe Enterprise UX practice at HelloFresh is a cross-functional team that brings physical and digital product and service experiences to life through strategic research, service design, prototyping, and storytelling. We are dedicated to transforming enterprise ways of working by applying structured methods like Definition Sprints, Service Blueprinting, and AS-IS and TO-BE mapping, creating meaningful & effective enterprise experiences to shape the future of HelloFresh’s Supply Chain.As a Senior Service Designer, you will leverage your research and service design expertise to shape compelling visions for both product and process improvements. You will deeply investigate current ways of working—identifying key data archetypes, mapping AS-IS states, and collaboratively defining desired TO-BE workflows. Your insights will identify the most impactful opportunities for investment. You will closely collaborate with product, engineering, users and operational stakeholders to design, prototype, and validate scalable solutions aligned with our Enterprise Design System.About the DomainThe wider Food Systems Alliance owns technology that enables a lean and sustainable procurement process from Suppliers to HelloFresh facilities and improves customer experience with accurate ingredient data flow and optimal ingredient quality. Optimising cost of ingredients, providing customers with the freshest and best ingredients, and enabling buying decisions that reduce excess stock and other forms of inventory waste are just some of the focus areas for this alliance.What you’ll do- Conduct and lead strategic Definition Sprints to uncover user needs, validate hypotheses, and collaboratively define clear next steps for design and development.- Map current (AS-IS) enterprise processes and systems, identifying pain points and opportunities, then collaboratively design optimized (TO-BE) processes, particularly within the Food Systems alliance  - the cluster that takes care of supply chain management topics within Hello Fresh..- Partner and inspire other enterprise designers to excel in service design and prototyping, nurturing growth within the team.- Deeply understand the user journeys and workflows of Recipe Developers, Menu Planners, and Buyers, building strong stakeholder relationships to advocate effectively for these users.- Develop and align design concepts and prototypes with the Enterprise Design System to ensure scalability and consistency across enterprise tooling.- Form collaborative partnerships with POs, engineers, and researchers, using influence to elevate UX solutions and challenge broader assumptions within internal product teams.- Mentor and coach designers in creating user experiences demonstrating pride in craft, clarity, and effectiveness.- Create UX/UI flows and experiences that elegantly address complex enterprise problems with delightful, user-centric solutions.- Facilitate clear communication across teams, leveraging structured storytelling methods to amplify your impact.Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.What you’ll bring- 4+ years of product design experience, particularly within enterprise or B2B contexts.- Proven track record in applying structured service design methodologies such as Definition Sprints, AS-IS/TO-BE mapping, and Service Blueprinting.- Additional experience leading projects, mentoring, or directly managing design team members.- A portfolio demonstrating impactful, user-centered enterprise experiences and a high level of craft.- Expertise in visual design, interaction design, UX writing, and UI design.- Mastery of Figma and familiarity with relevant prototyping and service design tools.- Excellent communication skills in English, capable of articulating complex concepts clearly to diverse stakeholders.What we offerElevate your lifestyle! Join one of Europe's fastest-growing tech powerhouses in a dynamic phase of expansion.- Immerse yourself in a diverse global community of 90+ nationalities.- Enjoy a competitive compensation package that goes beyond the norm, with perks like a HelloFresh- subsidized Pension Scheme, Berlin relocation support, and a Hybrid working model.- Elevate your lifestyle with exclusive discounts on your weekly HelloFresh box and office meals.- Invest in your growth with a German language learning budget, and access to the HelloFresh Academy.- Plus, we've got your well-being covered with mental health support, transportation perks, and working-parent-friendly benefits. From our 24/7 gym access,wellbeing platforms like Headspace and Spill, to sabbatical leave options, HelloFresh is not just a workplace; it's a lifestyle of perks and possibilities!Ergänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Expertenkenntnisse: User Experience Design

Your roleAs (Senior) Site Financial Controller (f/m/d/x) you will be part of the Controlling and FP&A team responsible for Factor EU. Our Team is tasked with safeguarding and owning the financial health of the companies operating in Germany, Belgium, Netherlands, Denmark and Sweden. Specifically, they are focused on everything in and around the P&L. We maintain and drive a by-annual budget cycle, serve as active business partners to the operations teams, and execute an impeccable and audit-proof financial closing round each month end. The team strives for continuous improvement in all financial and operational processes and is expected to proactively move the business forward on its profitable growth trajectory. You are responsible for all things finance at our production site in Verden. The role is broad and demanding and therefore requires excellent fundamentals in operational controlling, management accounting, and financial accounting. This position reports to the Head of Finance of Factor EU. The role can be based out of the site in Verden or Hybrid, based in our offices in Berlin. If hybrid, regular visits at the site are mandatory (~20%).Your area of responsibility- You own the weekly and monthly financial reporting for F_EU warehousing and production operations- You own the month end closing cycle for the operations, starting with accruals and finishing with high quality variance analysis- You work with the Finance team and the fulfillment teams at the site to prepare and ensure quality inventory records- You execute the quarterly and annual business planning for both production sites- You execute long-term scenario analyses and forecasting as it relates to site operations- You serve as a reliable finance business partner to F_EU finance leadership, the production site leadership, site HR departments and the global production leadership. You challenge, sensitize and support workforce staffing and compensation decisions.- You continuously improve the processes that stand behind all aspects of F_EU operations financial reporting, budgeting and controllingYour profile- You have a university degree in STEM-related fields, Business Administration, Finance or Economics - You have gained a minimum 3+ years of experience in a similar operations - finance controlling role- You know your way around a P&L and are highly fluent in financial and management accounting topics- You have strong financial modeling skills- You have a great interest in operational processes and their impact on financial outcomes- You excel at business partnering through strong communication, organization, and a hands-on mentality- You are able to solve problems in a structured and transparent way- You are based out of Verden or with an ability to travel regularly via train- Deadlines do not bother you, but rather motivate you- SQL skills are a strong plus- Prior touchpoints with Adaptive and Oracle are a plus but not required - You are fluent in English, German is a plus.What we offer you- Growth & Development: Internal training opportunities plus a yearly Learning & Development budget- **Food & Lifestyle:**Discounts on Factor_-boxes- **Compensation & Vacation:**Competitive salary and 30 days of vacation- **Health & Well-being:**Access to well-being initiatives, with discounted fitness offers currently being rolled out- **Future Benefits:**We’re working on introducing additional perks, including mobility support and a company pension scheme, to give our team even more flexibility and securityAre you up for a challenge?Apply now with your complete application documents, also without a photo and without stating specific personal characteristics such as nationality or gender if you choose to do so. jobs.occupation: Senior Electronics PCB & ECAD Design Engineer - RF & Mixed Signal (m/f/d) (Forschungs- und Entwicklungsingenieur/in)
jobs.description: RoleHive Robotics is building Europe’s first full-stack orchestration platform for unmanned systems: connecting, controlling, and commanding multi-vendor drone and robot swarms. Our RF communication systems are Made in Germany, deployed on active frontlines, and targeting a highly valued tactical communication market with zero sovereign alternatives today.As our Senior Electronics Hardware Engineer, you own our electronic designs end to end: from requirements through schematic capture, PCB layout, and manufacturing release to bring-up and debugging. You take a hardware requirement and independently turn it into a robust, manufacturable PCB assembly, spot problems early, and keep projects moving without waiting for direction. This is a hands-on individual contributor role. Most importantly, you enjoy designing hardware yourself and seeing it ship. You report into our CTO organization.Bring-up, rework, and close work with mechanical, firmware, and production happen hands-on in our Munich office, so we expect you on site most days of the week.ResponsibilitiesSchematic & PCB Design- Own electronic hardware designs from requirements to manufacturing release, including schematics and design reviews- Select components based on performance, availability, lifecycle, cost, and manufacturability- Place and route multilayer boards, and define stack-ups, design rules, controlled-impedance requirements, and layout constraints- Review designs for manufacturability, reliability, EMC, signal and power integrity, and thermal behavior where relevant- Design with certification in mind: support EMC and radio (CE/RED) pre-compliance and certification testing with external labs, and feed the findings back into the designECAD Libraries & Engineering Data- Create and maintain schematic symbols, footprints, padstacks, and ECAD libraries- Define and maintain electrical, physical, and manufacturing design rule sets- Keep engineering data clean: design documentation, revision history, and versioning that let anyone pick up a design later and improve it- Improve engineering workflows and automate repetitive tasks where it pays offManufacturing & Supply- Generate, review, and release manufacturing outputs and technical documentation- Work directly with PCB fabrication and PCBA assembly partners on stack-ups, fabrication constraints, assembly guidelines, and production requirements- Review BOMs and qualify alternative components based on availability, lifecycle, and technical requirements, together with Operations- Make sure designs scale from prototype runs to serial production volumesBring-up, Test & Integration- Bring up, debug, and validate boards, including burn-in testing, soldering, and rework- Work closely with mechanical and embedded firmware engineers through design, integration, and bring-up- Reproduce and qualify hardware issues from production and the field so they get fixed at the root cause- Handle sensitive and export-controlled design data in line with our dual-use export control requirementsRequirementsYou do not need to tick every box or master every topic from day one. If the core is there and you have the drive to grow into the rest, we want to hear from you.Must Have- 5+ years of professional experience in electronic hardware and PCB development- Degree in electrical engineering, electronics, or a comparable technical foundation- A track record of independently taking PCBs from schematic to manufacturing release: boards you designed that went into production- Strong schematic design and component selection skills, working confidently from datasheets- Strong PCB layout skills on multilayer and high-density boards, including blind and buried vias, built on a solid understanding of grounding, power distribution, differential interfaces, controlled impedance, and high-speed design- Practical understanding of PCB fabrication and PCBA assembly, including direct work with manufacturers on stack-ups, fabrication rules, assembly requirements, and production issues- Hands-on lab skills: board bring-up, debugging, lab equipment, soldering, and rework- Strong experience in at least one professional ECAD environment, such as Cadence OrCAD/Allegro, Siemens Xpedition, or comparable. - Ownership mindset: you drive designs forward without continuous supervision, and an undocumented design change is a problem for you, not a shortcut- Fluent English (German is a plus)- Willingness to undergo security vetting where projects require it- Based in Munich or willing to relocateNice to Have- Cadence OrCAD/Allegro, which our existing products are built on- Experience with BOM management or component lifecycle tools- RF and wireless electronics or communication systems, the core of what we build- Ethernet and high-speed digital interfaces, power electronics, or embedded systems- EMC/EMI-conscious design and experience taking products through EMC and radio certification (CE/RED)- Electronics for robotics, UAVs, or other ruggedized systems, ideally in defense, aerospace, or another regulated environment- Connector selection, wiring harness, and pinout definition- Scripting or engineering automationAbout usWe work in deep-tech and dual-use technology, an industry where women and other underrepresented groups have historically had limited access. We encourage you to apply even if you don't check every box below.Why Hive- Build sovereign technology that matters. We build RF communication and orchestration systems for unmanned platforms across air, land, sea, and space, at a moment when European technological sovereignty is a real strategic question, not an abstract one.- Real ownership, real deployment. Our products are already in serial production and in the field. What you build ships, and you see the result.- Small team, direct access. Around 30 people. You'll work directly with founders and not through multiple layers of management.- You shape the foundations. We're still building the structures, career paths, controlling, compliance, that let a fast-growing company scale well. You'll help decide what they look like.- Modern Munich office, with the tools and equipment to do your best work.What You Get- Compensation. We benchmark salaries to stay competitive for the market and the role, not just what an early-stage budget can spare.- Equity. You participate in Hive through equity/VSOP, a genuine stake in what we build, not just a paycheck.- A role you shape, not one you're handed. We're too early for fixed job descriptions or a career ladder. What you own grows as you take on more, not by climbing steps someone else defined.- No bureaucracy. Small, flat team. Decisions happen in a conversation, not a sign-off chain.Compensation and equity terms vary by role and level.Hive Robotics is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications regardless of race, ethnic origin, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, or marital status. Please don't include data on ethnic origin, political views, religious beliefs, union membership, health, or sexual orientation in your application.Ergänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Grundkenntnisse: Leiterplatten-Designsysteme (PCB-Design)

jobs.occupation: Data & AI Engineer (all genders), PharmaHera Service GmbH (Data-Warehouse-Analyst/in)
jobs.description: Deine neue Umgebung: Behind PharmaHera is Atida - one of Europe's leading online pharmacy groups, serving over 5 million customers across 9 countries. Together with the CEPD Group, we combine more than 25 years of pharmaceutical expertise with digital excellence to redefine the online pharmacy experience: We are building a trusted, personalized health ecosystem that guides people from prevention to cure - backed by medical expertise and driven by our conviction: Pharmacy is about people. Based in Berlin, we serve as the group's competence center for Germany and the Netherlands. As a specialized partner, we manage e-commerce, marketing, IT, and logistics for our local mail-order pharmacies, such as APONEO. Our European markets run on a single, standardized data platform (our Foundation layer). Your mission for the future: To transform this data infrastructure so it is not only usable by people, but specifically prepared for AI agents that read, analyze, and autonomously act on it. The role Reporting to the Data & AI Engineer Lead, you will own the data pipelines, datasets, AI agents and tools built on top of Foundation, and you will build most of them with AI agents as part of your toolchain. The role sits one level of abstraction above the code: you specify, review and take responsibility for systems rather than typing every line. Core responsibilities Pipeline development: build and optimize data flows in Apache Airflow, from our European markets into BigQuery. Modeling in BigQuery: implement tables and views in the Foundation layer, guaranteeing KPI comparability across Spain, France, Italy and Germany. Semantic layer and data contracts: keep business definitions consistent across dashboards, models and agents, and define the schema, granularity and quality a dataset guarantees. AI-assisted delivery: use Claude Code and the Anthropic API as your everyday engineering environment -- turn a requirement into a precise specification, let the agent produce the pipeline, then review, test and own the result. Building for agents: expose Foundation through MCP tools and skills so that AIDA and our decision agents can query it reliably. A dataset is finished when an agent can use it without being misled. Evaluation: build the evals, checks and monitoring that tell us whether an agent's output is correct. Unit tests are not enough for non-deterministic systems. Data products: design data products for management, finance, commercial, operations and marketing -- reusable across markets. Visualization and reporting: work with the business team on reports and consumable datasets in Apache Superset. Code and traceability: clean Python and SQL, with every task traceable through our GitLab-Coda integration. Agent-generated code included. Your Profile & Tech Stack What You Bring to the Role (Must-Haves): Education & Experience: 2+ years of hands-on experience in Data Engineering or Data Science. AI-Assisted Engineering: Regular, demonstrable use of an LLM coding agent (Claude Code or equivalent) in daily work, plus the technical judgment to critically review agent-generated code. Tech Stack & Cloud: Solid experience with Google Cloud Platform (especially BigQuery), Apache Airflow, strong SQL, data-oriented Python, and version control via Git/GitLab. Languages: Fluent English for daily collaboration within our international team. Mindset & Work Ethic: Strong analytical skills, an independent and results-focused approach ("you get the problem and context, the solution design is yours to propose"), and a commitment to deeply understanding code rather than using AI as a blind shortcut. What Rounds Off Your Profile (Nice-to-Haves): Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol), LLM APIs, ClearML, Docker, or Apache Druid. Know-how in evaluating non-deterministic systems and using BI tools (ideally Apache Superset). Industry experience in the healthcare, pharmacy, or e-commerce sectors, plus basic knowledge of German. What we are not looking for Someone who ships code they cannot explain. Someone who needs a ticket with the solution already inside it or with full requirements in place. We act fast: you get the problem, the context and access -- the design is yours to propose. Someone who uses AI as a shortcut and doesn't understand the problem they are solving. Someone who only thinks short-term. We build future-proof solutions. What You'll Get Your Work Environment: Freedom to Shape Your Role from Day 1: A position of responsibility with real opportunities for growth, where you can proactively drive initiatives and actively help shape strategies. Permanent, Full-Time Position: Long-term prospects in a future-proof market. Agile Work Environment: A motivated, dynamic team and flat hierarchies with short decision-making paths that enable fast execution. Flexibility with Team Spirit: Flexible working hours and a hybrid work model (mobile work & in-office) - with a focus on our Berlin office to foster collaboration and team cohesion. Direct Mentoring: Close collaboration and mentoring by the Data & AI Engineer Lead in a technically demanding environment. Hands-on Production Tech Stack: Real-world experience with Airflow, BigQuery, Druid, GCP, and a modern production AI stack (Claude, MCP, Agents, Evals). Professional AI Tooling: First-class AI engineering tools come as standard equipment. Your Benefits at a Glance: Health & Mobility: Urban Sports Club membership at an unbeatable price and a heavily discounted BVG corporate transit pass for your daily commute. jobs.occupation: Digital Guest Service / Customer Support Supervisor (all genders) Hospitality in Berlin (Reservierungssachbearbeiter/in (Hotel))
jobs.description: We're building the future of urban stays. One city at a time.Homaris exists to solve one of the most persistent problems in modern cities: People from abroad need places to live, work, and just feel at home. We build and operate fully digitised serviced apartments across Germany´s major cities – next step: Europe and beyond.And a product vision — the nanopartment® — that reimagines what urban stays can look like in the smallest possible space. Revenue triples within two years — organically. No venture capital. No exit strategy. We are in this for the long run, and we build accordingly. Extraordinary people make this happen - and we're looking for one more.Your RoleYou run the operational core of our digital guest service. Working from our Berlin headquarters, you join the Guest Service Supervisor team as the central point of contact for our Guest Service Agents worldwide. You make sure guests experience reliable care, and you free up the teams who speak with them every day. At the helm of our digital front desk, you keep every guest stay running smoothly behind the scenes.What You'll Do Operations. You support the Guest Service team in day-to-day work and keep our apartments running smoothly from behind the scenes.Quality. You design new quality concepts, monitor compliance with our standards in guest communication, and train the Agents continuously.Communication. You draft message templates that reach our guests reliably, personally and in the right tone.Second Level. You are the go-to contact for Agents when a case gets complex, and you take ownership when it matters most.Onboarding. You support the onboarding of new colleagues and the ongoing development of existing team members.Deputising. You cover for the Guest Service Team Lead during absences and keep the entire team in view.Interfaces. You coordinate closely with internal departments and external service partners, as a dependable partner who sees solutions through.What Makes You a Fit Service with Standards. You have a strong service mindset and are comfortable working at different times of day, including weekends on a regular, planned rotation.Experience. You bring professional experience as a Reservation Agent or Manager, Call Center Agent, Receptionist, or from another service-driven industry.Organisation. You organise and coordinate with confidence and approach problems with a solution-first mindset.Communication. You connect easily with different personalities and convey points of view, ideas and solutions clearly.Digital Tools. You work with software and digital solutions effortlessly. Experience with booking platforms and the property management systems Apaleo or Guesty is a plus.Languages. You speak and write German and English fluently (both at C1).Digital Curiosity. You spot potential in new tools and are excited about how AI can make your daily work more efficient.The EnvironmentHomaris is a company with the maximum of long-term orientation. We don't burn cash to grow fast and sell. We build something real, and we expect the people who join us to want to build it with us — not to optimise for others. The pace is high. The problems are real. The team is small enough that every person matters. We're not always great at seeing and celebrating our wins. But we're working on it — and we'd love your help with that.What We OfferWe define levels by the work you own and the decisions you're accountable for, not by your title or years of experience. Beyond that: we've thought carefully about what people actually need to do their best work and live well — and we've built a benefits package that reflects that. Health, mobility, development, flexibility, and a few perks that come with being in the travel and hospitality business. Not much is missing. We'll walk you through the details when we meet.Next StepsIf this opportunity resonates with you, we’d be glad to learn more about your experience and perspective. Just send us your CV.Questions? Reach out to Natalie at karriere@homaris.de or +49 157 92465807. We value diversity and welcome applications from people of all genders, cultures and backgrounds.About usHomaris is a leading provider of serviced nano-apartments in prime urban locations and is pioneering a new generation of space-efficient apartment concepts with its nanopartment®. With more than 4,500 apartments secured under contract in cities including Berlin, Hamburg, Munich, Cologne, Frankfurt, Stuttgart, Düsseldorf and Dresden, Homaris ranks among Germany’s leading serviced-apartment brands. The company serves contemporary customer segments, including business travellers, tourists, digital nomads and corporate clients.The Homaris concept is based on the integration of a fully digitalised guest journey with maximum space efficiency, multifunctional design and intelligent space solutions. The nanopartment® is Homaris’s signature product, embodying innovative space efficiency, modern minimalism and a modular design concept that combines living, working and a sense of arrival within a compact footprint. Rotating, folding and sliding mechanisms allow the space to be reconfigured according to individual needs. In the future, the system is intended to become a standard feature across Homaris’s upcoming properties.

Short DescriptionSPREAD builds Engineering Intelligence for complex products. Our AI-native platform gives automotive OEMs, defense primes and industrial manufacturers one connected view of their product data, and Volkswagen, BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Audi, Bosch and Rheinmetall already run it. We are backed by HV Capital, DTCP, La Famiglia and Salesforce, won the SPARK AI Innovation Award, and made LinkedIn's Top Startups in DACH list.Role: Getting a first meeting with an engineering director at an OEM is the hardest step in our funnel, and this role owns it. You sit between Business Development and Revenue Operations, report to our Head of Revenue, and work every day with the BDRs and Account Executives. Half your time goes to pipeline, which means finding the right accounts and people and building the plays that reach them; the other half goes to the engine behind those plays, which you build with Claude Code rather than by hand, so the sales team spends its hours in conversations instead of research and data entry. Your work counts when it turns into meetings and pipeline, not when another dashboard ships. The person we picture did BDR or SDR work, liked the tooling and the process more than the cold calls, and now builds agents because they want to.Your Mission• Design, launch, and test outbound plays into automotive and industrial engineering accounts, each with a hypothesis and a conversion number, track each play from first touch to qualified opportunity, and retire the ones that do not convert.• Run cadences across email, phone and LinkedIn in German and English together with the BDRs and AEs, and write first touches good enough that the reps reuse them.• Turn our Account News feed, which scores news, hiring and leadership changes every night, into meetings with the people those signals point to.• Build account maps, contact scores and segments for campaigns and events, so every play starts from the right twenty people rather than the right two thousand.• Run Clay enrichment triggered from Salesforce, so reps get emails, phone numbers and titles without asking anyone.• Build jobs.description: The Friedrich-Alexander-University (FAU) Erlangen-Nürnberg has been rated as one of the most innovative universities in Europe by Reuters or Times Higher Education. FAU and the University Hospital Erlangen (UKER) , which are located in the City of Erlangen in the North of Bavaria, Germany, carry out top-level research in immunology and have consistently ranked among the most successful German universities in attracting funding from the German Research Foundation ( Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft, DFG ) in the medical field of "Microbiology, Virology and Immunology". The FAU Profile Center Immunomedicine (FAU I-Med) unites more than 130 independent research groups from FAU, the UKER and the Max Planck Center for Physics and Medicine, which participate in numerous DFG-funded research  consortia and provide a strong scientific environment.One of these DFG-funded research consortia is the Research Training Group (RTG; Graduiertenkolleg, GRK) 2740 "ImmunoMicroTope" , which has been headed by Prof. Christian Bogdan since 2022. It is run by 13 outstanding research group leaders of the University Hospital Erlangen and the FAU and maintains close cooperations with two laboratories at the Universities of Regensburg and Cologne. The RTG 2740 focuses on the in situ analysis of the tissue microenvironment, the micromilieu factors and the metabolites that determine the immune response against bacterial, parasitic and fungal pathogens. The overarching goal of the consortium is the characterization of the complex "immunomicrotope" during infections (Bogdan et al., Trends in Parasitology 2024 10.1016/j.pt.2024.07.013 ( https://doi.org/10.1016/j.pt.2024.07.013 ) ).Your tasks:Within the RTG2740 "ImmunoMicroTope ", Prof. Christian Bogdan offers a PhD position in his dynamic research team in the project B2 "Role of sex and microbiota for the curative effect of L-arginine in chronic cutaneous leishmaniasis due to Leishmania mexicana infection".Type 2 nitric oxide synthase (NOS2) converts the amino acid L-arginine in the presence of molecular oxygen into nitric oxide (NO), which exerts antimicrobial and immunoregulatory functions. In previous studies, Prof. Bogdan's group showed that NOS2 is essential for the type 1 T helper cell-dependent control of intracellular pathogens, including the protozoan parasite Leishmania. In contrast, the expression of arginase 1 correlated with the progression of disease, pathogen persistence and immunopathology. Moreover, the group observed that the non-healing, chronic course of cutaneous leishmaniasis in Leishmania mexicana- infected female mice was prevented and reversed by external application of L-arginine. Currently, it is unclear, whether this effect is sex-dependent and whether it is influenced by the cutaneous and/or intestinal microbiota. The project aims to address these questions and to provide new mechanistic insights into the therapeutic effect of L-arginine with the ultimate goal to establish a new host-targeted treatment for chronic cutaneous leishmaniasis.For more information, please visit www.immunomicrotope.de ( https://www.immunomicrotope.de/beispiel-seite/project-areas/project-area-b-metabolism/b2-characterization-and-integrative-bioinformatic-modeling-of-metabolic-and-micro-milieu-factors-promoting-leishmania-survival/ ) and www.mikrobiologie.uk-erlangen.de/en/research/research-groups/research-group-of-prof-c-bogdan ( https://www.mikrobiologie.uk-erlangen.de/forschung/forschergruppen-arbeitsgruppen/ag-prof-c-bogdan/ ) /.( http://www.immunomicrotope.de/ )Essential experience/qualifications:- Master’s Degree in immunology or a related subject of life sciences (e.g., microbiology/microbiome research, parasitology, cell biology)- Excellent academic performance and high level of scientific interest- Practical and theoretical experience in the field of infectious disease immunology and microbiome analyses- Very good knowledge of bioinformatic programs and experience in bioinformatic analyses- Experience in mammalian cell culture, cell and molecular biology methods (e.g., flow cytometry, RNA/DNA isolation, quantitative PCR, ChIP, bulk and scRNAseq) and fluorescence (confocal) microscopy- Enthusiasm for experimental and bioinformatic work and for establishing new experimental methods and techniques- High responsibility, initiative, ambition, and motivation- Team spirit- Very good English language skills (C1 level or higher)- Proficiency in MS Office, Excel, Prism, Illustrator etc.Additionally beneficial are:- Experience with experimental in vivo mouse models- FELASA B certificate- Experience with imaging methods- Experience in the field of parasitology- Knowledge of the German languageComments:- The program starts on July 1 st 2027- The PhD position is available for initially 36 months- Pay grade is determined according to the qualifications and personal requirements as defined by TV-L E13- Please provide a single PDF file (last name_first name.pdf ) consisting of the following documents in English language:- Completed application form (RTG 2740 Application form_PhD; www.immunomicrotope.de ( https://www.immunomicrotope.de/how-to-apply/ ) )- Curriculum vitae- Letter of motivation- One-page summary each of the bachelor and master thesis- Copies of the university entrance exam, Bachelor exam and Master exam- Two letters of reference- Other credentials and information relevant to the RTG2740 programPlease note that applications that do not fulfill these formal requirements, will not be considered. Deadline for application is January 15, 2027. The recruitment symposium will take place at the end of February 2027.We offer:- Participation in the 3-year qualification program of the RTG2740, which combines profound, internationally oriented scientific training with an early exposure to important aspects of translational research- Well equipped lab with access to the latest technologies (e.g., bulk and scRNA sequencing; microbiome analysis; confocal, light sheet and high-resolution microscopy; transcriptomics) and core-facilities- A stimulating, collaborative, and international research environment formed by the FAU Profile Center Immunomedicine ( https://www.immunology.fau.de/ ), various collaborative research consortia, and the Max-Planck-Center for Physics and Medicine- Continuous supervision and advice by a scientific mentoring committee- Participation in national and international workshops, symposia, conferences, and an international laboratory exchange- All public service benefits, including supplementary benefits from the Federal and State Government Pension Fund (VBL)Further information:Prof. Dr. Christian BogdanResearch group leader, head of the institute and spokesman of RTG2740Tel. +49 9131 8532561Dr. Ilka KnippertzScientific ManagingTel.: +49 9131 8532571Applications:Universitätsklinikum ErlangenInstitut für Klinische Mikrobiologie, Immunologie und HygieneProf. Dr. Christian BogdanWasserturmstraße 3-5D-91054 Erlangen, Germany
